catalog.name: Financial Reporting calculations
catalog.description: Every formula, algorithm, rounding rule and worked example of the financial reporting domain, in a structured form a rebuild can test against: the sign conventions, the nine-step evaluation pipeline and its base restriction, the exact evaluation of all six computation engines with every reducer and every subformula clause, the six date windows and the carry-forward correction, the comparison and growth arithmetic, the unfolding, grouping, prefix-group and hierarchy algorithms, the carry-over mechanism in both of its shipped variants, the rounding order and the presentation rules, the line formulas of every shipped statement, three complete national returns, the tax closing computation with its ledger consequences, and the integrity hash chain.
catalog.authored_from: docs/domains/financial-reporting/calculations.md, with the closing entry formulas of docs/domains/financial-reporting/accounting-effects.md that section sixteen points to, and the rule identifiers of docs/domains/financial-reporting/business-rules.md

records.name: The signed balance of a Journal Item
records.purpose: Gives the single signed figure from which every ledger amount of the reporting domain derives, so that no engine has to read the debit column and the credit column separately.

operands.name: item debit
operands.unit_or_currency: the currency of the item's company
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: not negative; zero on a credit item

operands.name: item credit
operands.unit_or_currency: the currency of the item's company
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: not negative; zero on a debit item

preconditions.condition: Exactly one of the two amounts is non-zero on an ordinary item.
preconditions.otherwise: A zero-amount item has both at zero and its balance is zero, which is a valid result and not an error.

procedure: Read the debit amount of the item in the currency of its company.
Read the credit amount of the item in the same currency.
Subtract the credit from the debit.
records.formula: item_balance = item_debit − item_credit

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded here: both amounts are already stored at the precision of the company currency.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the company currency.
rounding.method: Not applicable at this step; presentation rounding happens once, at display.
rounding.step: No rounding step; the subtraction is exact over two stored amounts.

result.name: item balance
result.unit_or_currency: the currency of the item's company
result.stored_or_displayed: Held on the Journal Item and summed by every ledger-reading engine of the domain; never displayed on its own on a report line.

edge_cases.case: A debit item.
edge_cases.outcome: The balance is positive.

edge_cases.case: A credit item.
edge_cases.outcome: The balance is negative.

edge_cases.case: An item with both amounts at zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The balance is zero, which is a figure and not an absence of figure.

edge_cases.case: An engine needs the direction of an account rather than its amount.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the balance-character filter of the account code prefix engine needs it, and it obtains it by testing the sign of the summed balance, never by reading the two columns.

worked_examples.description: A credit sales item of twelve thousand
worked_examples.narrative: Zero minus twelve thousand is minus twelve thousand, so a sales credit enters every sum as a negative figure.

worked_examples.description: A debit item of three hundred
worked_examples.narrative: Three hundred minus zero is three hundred, so a debit enters every sum as a positive figure.

records.name: The presentation sign of a report line
records.purpose: Turns the raw signed balance into the sign the statement wants to show, entirely through the report definition, so that no engine ever guesses a sign from the type of an account.

operands.name: raw figure of the line
operands.source: the engine that evaluated the line's expression
operands.constraints: the signed sum of the selected Journal Items

operands.name: negation instruction
operands.source: the report definition: a leading minus on a term or on a tag formula, or a multiplication by minus one in an aggregation formula
operands.constraints: authored per line, never derived

preconditions.condition: The report definition states the sign it wants.
preconditions.otherwise: The raw signed balance is displayed as it stands, so a credit balance shows as a negative figure.

procedure: Evaluate the line's expression and obtain the raw signed figure.
Read the negation instruction of the definition: a leading minus on an account code prefix term, a leading minus on a tax tag formula, or a multiplication by minus one in an aggregation formula.
When a negation instruction is present, multiply the raw figure by minus one.
Display the result.
records.formula:
displayed_figure = −1 × raw_figure    when the definition negates
displayed_figure =      raw_figure    otherwise

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded by the sign step.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: The sign is applied before any presentation rounding.

result.name: displayed figure of the line
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell of the line and of the column; it is the figure every aggregation over that line reads.

edge_cases.case: An asset line of the balance sheet.
edge_cases.outcome: Asset accounts carry debit balances, the raw figure is already positive and the definition does not negate.

edge_cases.case: A liability or equity line of the balance sheet.
edge_cases.outcome: The definition negates, so an amount owed reads positive.

edge_cases.case: An income line of the profit and loss statement.
edge_cases.outcome: The definition negates, so revenue earned reads positive.

edge_cases.case: An expense line of the profit and loss statement.
edge_cases.outcome: The raw figure is already positive and the definition does not negate.

edge_cases.case: An output tax line of a tax return.
edge_cases.outcome: The tag expression carries a leading minus, so tax owed to the authorities reads positive.

edge_cases.case: An input tax line of a tax return.
edge_cases.outcome: No minus is used, because tax reclaimable sits on the debit side and is already positive.

edge_cases.case: The aged payable report.
edge_cases.outcome: The residual is negated so that an amount the company owes reads positive; the aged receivable report uses the residual as it stands.

worked_examples.description: A liability line whose accounts total a credit of eight thousand four hundred
worked_examples.narrative: Minus one times minus eight thousand four hundred is eight thousand four hundred, so the amount owed reads positive on the balance sheet.

worked_examples.description: An expense line whose accounts total a debit of six hundred and twelve
worked_examples.narrative: No negation is applied, so the cost incurred reads positive on the profit and loss statement.

records.name: The rendered value of a figure that rounds to zero
records.purpose: Fixes what a cell shows when the figure is zero or becomes zero at the presentation precision, so that no report ever prints a negative zero and so that the blank-if-zero flag is honoured.

operands.name: figure of the cell
operands.source: the engine that produced it
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: presentation precision
operands.source: the presentation currency, or the rounding clause of the expression
operands.constraints: not negative

operands.name: blank-if-zero flag
operands.source: the expression or the column of the report definition
operands.constraints: when set, a zero cell is left empty instead of showing a zero

preconditions.condition: The display type of the cell is monetary.
preconditions.otherwise: A figure of another display type is rendered by the rules of that type; the zero rule still forbids a negative zero.

procedure: Round the figure to the presentation precision.
When the rounded figure is zero and the blank-if-zero flag is set on the expression or on the column, leave the cell empty.
When the rounded figure is zero and the flag is not set, display the rounded zero, never the unrounded value and never a minus sign in front of it.
Otherwise display the rounded figure with its sign.
records.formula:
rendered = empty                              when round( figure ) = 0 and blank_if_zero
rendered = 0                                  when round( figure ) = 0 and not blank_if_zero
rendered = round( figure )                    otherwise

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, or the number of decimals of the expression's rounding clause when it carries one.
rounding.step: At display, after every engine and every clause has produced the figure.

result.name: rendered cell
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the report; an empty cell and a zero cell are different and the difference is meaningful.

edge_cases.case: The figure is exactly zero.
edge_cases.outcome: A zero is displayed, never a minus zero.

edge_cases.case: The figure is minus four thousandths with two decimal places.
edge_cases.outcome: It rounds to zero and the rounded zero is displayed, not the unrounded value.

edge_cases.case: The blank-if-zero flag is set and the figure rounds to zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The cell is blanked.

edge_cases.case: The column has no expression of the cell's label.
edge_cases.outcome: The cell is empty rather than zero, which says the line has no such figure at all.

worked_examples.description: A monetary figure of minus four thousandths with two decimal places and no blank-if-zero flag
worked_examples.narrative: Minus four thousandths rounds to zero at two decimal places, and the zero is printed without a minus sign.

worked_examples.description: The same figure with the blank-if-zero flag set
worked_examples.narrative: The rounded figure is zero and the flag is set, so the cell is left empty.

records.name: The nine-step evaluation of a rendered report
records.purpose: Turns a report definition and a set of user options into an ordered list of rendered rows with one cell per column, and fixes the order in which the engines run so that an aggregation never reads a figure that has not been produced yet.

operands.name: report definition
operands.unit_or_currency: a report, a variant or a section
operands.source: the request
operands.constraints: must be available for the active company

operands.name: date option
operands.unit_or_currency: a single as-of date, or a from-date and a to-date, with the fiscal-year boundaries containing them
operands.source: the user options
operands.constraints: the from-date must not be after the to-date

operands.name: comparison option
operands.source: the user options
operands.constraints: at most one when growth is enabled

operands.name: company option
operands.unit_or_currency: an ordered set of companies, or a tax unit
operands.source: the user options
operands.constraints: at least one company

operands.name: journal, analytic, partner, account type, entries and unreconciled options
operands.source: the user options
operands.constraints: an empty set means no restriction

operands.name: unfolded lines
operands.source: the user options
operands.constraints: each identifier must belong to the report

operands.name: rounding unit
operands.source: the user options
operands.constraints: one of the three

operands.name: hide-zero option and horizontal split
operands.source: the user options
operands.constraints: independent of each other

preconditions.condition: The report is available for the active company.
preconditions.otherwise: The report is not offered and the request is refused.

preconditions.condition: Every cross-report reference of the collected expressions resolves.
preconditions.otherwise: The unresolvable reference raises the cross-report errors of the entities document and the cell is rendered empty.

preconditions.condition: The aggregation dependency graph has no cycle.
preconditions.otherwise: Evaluation stops and reports that the aggregation formulas of this report form a cycle through the named line code.

procedure: Resolve the report: continue with the selected variant when the requested report is a root report with variants, and, for a composite report, evaluate each section independently in section order and concatenate the results behind a heading line per section.
Build the base restriction over Journal Items from the company, journal, analytic, partner, account-type, entries and unreconciled options.
Collect the expressions of every line of the report and expand the aggregation dependency graph so that every referenced expression, in this report or in another, is included.
Partition the collected expressions by the pair of engine and date scope, one evaluation pass per group.

Evaluate every group whose engine is not the aggregation engine, in any order, obtaining per expression and per period column a figure and, for the auditable engines, the restriction that selects the items behind it.
Evaluate the aggregation groups in dependency order, resolving each reference to a figure already produced and treating a reference that produced no figure as zero.

Apply the carry-over: read the values carried in for every expression labelled with the applied-carry-over prefix, and compute what must be carried out for every expression labelled with the carry-over prefix, remembering it without writing it.

Assemble the lines by walking the line tree depth-first, building one cell per column from the expression whose label equals the column's expression label, leaving the cell empty when there is none, then applying the hide-if-zero rule, the blank-if-zero rule, the rounding unit and the display types.
Expand the unfolded lines, inserting prefix-group levels wherever an expansion would exceed the prefix-group threshold.
records.formula:
rendered_report = assemble( evaluate_aggregations( evaluate_engines( expressions , base_restriction , date_windows ) ) )
number_of_column_groups = 1 + number_of_comparison_periods

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded during evaluation; every sum is accumulated at full stored precision.
rounding.precision: The presentation precision is applied only in the eighth step.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, at display.
rounding.step: Rounding happens once, when the cells are assembled, never on an intermediate sum.

result.name: rendered rows
result.unit_or_currency: rows carrying figures in the presentation currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed: each row carries an identifier, a level, a name, a foldable flag, an unfolded flag, a parent identifier, an optional action and one cell per column, and the result also carries the column headers grouped by period.

edge_cases.case: The report is composite.
edge_cases.outcome: Each section is evaluated independently and the results are concatenated, each behind a heading line carrying the section's name.

edge_cases.case: Two expressions sit in the same group.
edge_cases.outcome: They must produce the same figures whether they are evaluated together or separately: one expression's result may never narrow another's restriction.

edge_cases.case: An aggregation group depends on another aggregation group.
edge_cases.outcome: The dependent group is evaluated after the group it depends on; any other order is free.

edge_cases.case: A comparison column is rendered.
edge_cases.outcome: The whole pipeline runs again with only the date option replaced, and the carry-over is not recomputed for it.

edge_cases.case: A line has no expression of a column's label.
edge_cases.outcome: The cell is empty rather than zero.

worked_examples.description: A report of forty-one lines with one column and one comparison period
worked_examples.narrative: One plus one comparison period gives two column groups; every expression of the report is evaluated once per column group, in one pass per pair of engine and date scope.

worked_examples.description: A composite report of three sections rendered without comparison
worked_examples.narrative: Each of the three sections is evaluated on its own and preceded by one heading line carrying its name, and the single period gives one column group.

records.name: The base restriction over Journal Items
records.purpose: Defines the single set of Journal Items every ledger-reading engine may read, so that all the engines of one rendering see exactly the same slice of the ledger.

operands.name: selected companies
operands.source: the company option, or the companies of the selected tax unit
operands.constraints: at least one

operands.name: entry state
operands.unit_or_currency: the stored state of the item's Journal Entry
operands.source: the Journal Entry
operands.constraints: the value posted is always accepted, draft only when the draft option is on, cancel never

operands.name: selected journals
operands.source: the journal option
operands.constraints: an empty set accepts every journal

operands.name: selected analytic accounts and plans
operands.unit_or_currency: sets of analytic accounts and analytic plans
operands.source: the analytic option
operands.constraints: an empty set accepts every item

operands.name: selected partners and partner categories
operands.source: the partner option
operands.constraints: an empty set accepts every item

operands.name: account type option
operands.unit_or_currency: one of receivable, payable, both or disabled
operands.source: the user options
operands.constraints: disabled adds no condition

operands.name: unreconciled option
operands.source: the user options
operands.constraints: when on, only reconcilable accounts with a non-zero residual are kept

operands.name: row kind
operands.unit_or_currency: the display type of the item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: a section, a note or a line-break marker is never counted

operands.name: only-tax-exigible flag
operands.source: the report definition, or the cash-basis entries option
operands.constraints: when either applies, the exigibility test is added

preconditions.condition: At least one company is selected.
preconditions.otherwise: There is nothing to read and every figure is zero.

preconditions.condition: The from-date of the period is not after its to-date.
preconditions.otherwise: The period is empty and every ledger figure is zero; a rebuild should refuse the option rather than render zeros.

procedure: Keep the item when its company is one of the selected companies.
Keep the item when the state of its Journal Entry is posted, or draft while the draft option is on; never keep an item whose entry is cancelled.
When journals are selected, keep the item only when its journal is one of them.

When analytic accounts are selected, keep the item only when its analytic distribution names at least one of them; when analytic plans are selected, keep it only when the distribution names at least one account of one of those plans.
When partners are selected, keep the item only when its partner is one of them; when partner categories are selected, keep it only when its partner carries at least one of them.

Apply the account type option: receivable keeps only items on an account of the receivable type, payable only items on an account of the payable type, both keeps either, and disabled adds no condition.
When the unreconciled option is on, keep the item only when its account is reconcilable and its residual amount in company currency is not zero.
Drop every item whose display type is a section, a note or a line-break marker, keeping only rows that carry an amount.
When the report sets the only-tax-exigible flag, or when the cash-basis entries option is on, keep the item only when it passes the tax exigibility test.
records.formula:
base_restriction = company_condition AND entry_state_condition AND journal_condition
                 AND analytic_condition AND partner_condition AND account_type_condition
                 AND unreconciled_condition AND row_kind_condition AND exigibility_condition

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded: the restriction selects items, it does not compute an amount.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: The residual test of the unreconciled condition compares against zero at the precision of the company currency.

result.name: the set of readable Journal Items
result.stored_or_displayed: Not displayed; it is conjoined with the date window and the formula of every ledger-reading engine, and it is also the drill-down restriction of every auditable figure.

edge_cases.case: A company is selected for which the report is not available.
edge_cases.outcome: Its data is still included: availability governs which reports are offered, not which companies are read.

edge_cases.case: A tax unit is selected while the report's multi-company switch works by selector.
edge_cases.outcome: The unit is ignored and the companies are treated individually.

edge_cases.case: An account is archived.
edge_cases.outcome: Its items are still read; archival hides the account from pickers, not from history.

edge_cases.case: A saved journal-item filter is chosen.
edge_cases.outcome: It is conjoined as a further condition and narrows the item set for every ledger-reading engine at once, but never for the external value engine.

edge_cases.case: The cash-basis entries option is on.
edge_cases.outcome: The exigibility test is added even when the report does not set the only-tax-exigible flag.

worked_examples.description: A rendering for two companies, one journal and posted entries only
worked_examples.narrative: The company, entry state, journal, row kind and account type conditions apply; the analytic, partner, unreconciled and exigibility conditions add nothing, and no cancelled entry is ever read.

worked_examples.description: A tax report rendering with the only-tax-exigible flag set
worked_examples.narrative: The exigibility test is conjoined, so a payment-basis tax whose cash has not moved is excluded from every figure of the report.

records.name: The tax exigibility test of a Journal Item
records.purpose: Decides whether a Journal Item may enter a tax figure now, so that a tax that only falls due when the cash moves is reported in the period of the payment and not in the period of the document.

operands.name: whether the entry is always exigible
operands.source: the Journal Entry
operands.constraints: true when the entry is not an invoice-like document and produces no cash-basis values, that is carries no line bearing a payment-basis tax

operands.name: whether the item is a tax line or bears taxes
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: an item that carries only tags is neither

operands.name: whether the entry is a cash-basis entry
operands.source: the Journal Entry
operands.constraints: true when the entry was created by reconciling a payment against a document carrying payment-basis taxes

operands.name: the payment-basis flag of the item's tax
operands.source: the tax of the tax line
operands.constraints: read only when the item is a tax line

operands.name: the payment-basis flags of the taxes borne by the item
operands.source: the taxes of the item
operands.constraints: at least one not payment-basis makes the item exigible

preconditions.condition: The item belongs to a Journal Entry whose exigibility marking is known.
preconditions.otherwise: The first test cannot be evaluated and the item is treated as not exigible, so it is excluded.

procedure: Answer yes when the item's Journal Entry is flagged as always exigible.
Answer yes when the item is neither a tax line nor a line bearing taxes, that is when it carries only tags.
Answer yes when the item's Journal Entry is itself a cash-basis entry.
Answer yes when the item is a tax line whose tax is not payment-basis.
Answer yes when the item bears at least one tax that is not payment-basis.
Answer no when all five tests fail, and exclude the item: it belongs to a payment-basis tax whose cash has not yet moved.
records.formula:
tax_exigible( item ) = ( the entry is always exigible )
                    OR ( the item is neither a tax line nor a line bearing taxes )
                    OR ( the entry is a cash-basis entry )
                    OR ( the item is a tax line whose tax is not payment-basis )
                    OR ( at least one tax borne by the item is not payment-basis )

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded: the answer is a yes or no value.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: Not applicable.

result.name: the item is tax exigible
result.stored_or_displayed: Not displayed; it is conjoined into the base restriction whenever the only-tax-exigible flag is set or the cash-basis entries option is on.

edge_cases.case: A payment-basis tax on an unpaid invoice.
edge_cases.outcome: Excluded while the only-tax-exigible flag is on: its base item and its tax item are invisible to the tax report.

edge_cases.case: The same invoice after payment.
edge_cases.outcome: The cash-basis entry carries the same tags and is always exigible, so the amounts appear in the period of the payment.

edge_cases.case: An entry with no receivable and no payable line and no cash-basis values.
edge_cases.outcome: Always exigible, whatever its taxes.

edge_cases.case: An item carrying only tags, with no tax and no tax line reference.
edge_cases.outcome: Always exigible by the second test.

edge_cases.case: An item mixing a payment-basis tax and an invoice-basis tax that share a tag.
edge_cases.outcome: Refused by the ledger with the message "Taxes exigible on payment and on invoice cannot be mixed on the same journal item if they share some tag.", because such an item would be counted once on the document and once on the cash-basis entry.

worked_examples.description: A base item of an unpaid invoice bearing one payment-basis tax
worked_examples.narrative: All five tests fail, so the item is excluded while the only-tax-exigible flag is on.

worked_examples.description: The tax item of the cash-basis entry created when that invoice is paid
worked_examples.narrative: The third test succeeds unconditionally, so the amount enters the tax report in the period of the payment.

records.name: The raw sum of the record filter engine
records.purpose: Reduces the Journal Items an arbitrary condition selects to a single signed figure, which is the escape hatch used when neither account codes nor tax tags can express the selection.

operands.name: the matching Journal Items
operands.unit_or_currency: items carrying amounts in the presentation currency
operands.source: the ledger, restricted by the base restriction, by the date window of the expression's date scope and by the formula's own condition
operands.constraints: an item enters at most once

operands.name: debit of each matching item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: not negative

operands.name: credit of each matching item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: not negative

preconditions.condition: The formula parses as a literal record filter, with no function call, no variable and no arithmetic.
preconditions.otherwise: The formula is refused at write time with the formula error of the expression rules.

preconditions.condition: The expression carries a subformula, which is mandatory for this engine.
preconditions.otherwise: The record is refused by the stored check that requires a record filter expression to carry a subformula.

procedure: Take the Journal Items that satisfy the base restriction.
Keep only those inside the date window of the expression's date scope.
Keep only those that satisfy the formula's own condition, a literal list of triples of a field path, a comparison operator and a value, combined by the prefix logical operators.
Add the debit and subtract the credit of every kept item, accumulating at full stored precision.
records.formula: raw_sum = Σ over items m in the matching set of ( debit(m) − credit(m) )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and then the whole unit when the report sets an integer rounding mode.
rounding.step: Only at display; the sum itself is accumulated at full stored precision.

result.name: raw sum of the selection
result.stored_or_displayed: Not displayed on its own: it is the input of the reducer named by the subformula, whose result is displayed.

edge_cases.case: No item matches.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is zero, not empty; a zero is displayed unless the blank-if-zero flag is set.

edge_cases.case: The formula names an external identifier in the authoring shortcut field.
edge_cases.outcome: The reference is resolved to the referenced record's numeric identifier before the formula is stored, so what is stored is always literal.

edge_cases.case: An item matches two conditions of the same formula.
edge_cases.outcome: It still contributes once: the formula selects a set of items, not a multiset.

worked_examples.description: Three income items of a quarter, one of them excluded by the partner condition
worked_examples.narrative: Zero minus twelve thousand, plus zero minus four thousand five hundred, plus three hundred minus zero, gives minus sixteen thousand two hundred.

records.name: The record filter reducer that keeps only a positive total
records.purpose: Reports the selection's total only when it is a debit total, and reports nothing otherwise, which is how a box that may only carry one direction of a balance is declared.

operands.name: the matching Journal Items
operands.unit_or_currency: items carrying amounts in the presentation currency
operands.source: the ledger, restricted by the base restriction, by the date window of the expression's date scope and by the formula's own condition
operands.constraints: an item enters at most once

operands.name: debit of each matching item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: not negative

operands.name: credit of each matching item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: not negative

preconditions.condition: The formula parses as a literal record filter, with no function call, no variable and no arithmetic.
preconditions.otherwise: The formula is refused at write time with the formula error of the expression rules.

preconditions.condition: The expression carries a subformula, which is mandatory for this engine.
preconditions.otherwise: The record is refused by the stored check that requires a record filter expression to carry a subformula.

procedure: Compute the raw sum of the selection.
When the raw sum is greater than zero, the reducer result is the raw sum.
When the raw sum is zero or less, the reducer result is zero.
Apply the leading minus of the subformula afterwards, when there is one.
records.formula:
reducer_result = raw_sum    when raw_sum > 0
reducer_result = 0          when raw_sum ≤ 0

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and then the whole unit when the report sets an integer rounding mode.
rounding.step: At display, after the reducer and after any leading minus.

result.name: figure of the expression
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell of the line and of the column bound to the expression's label.

edge_cases.case: The raw sum is exactly zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The result is zero, because the test is strictly greater than zero.

edge_cases.case: The subformula carries a leading minus.
edge_cases.outcome: The negation is applied after the reducer, so the expression returns zero when the raw sum is negative and the negated sum when it is positive; it never returns a positive number.

edge_cases.case: No item matches.
edge_cases.outcome: The raw sum is zero and the result is zero.

worked_examples.description: The selection of the worked example, whose raw sum is negative
worked_examples.narrative: Minus sixteen thousand two hundred is not greater than zero, so the reducer returns zero.

worked_examples.description: A selection whose raw sum is a debit total of three hundred
worked_examples.narrative: Three hundred is greater than zero, so the reducer returns the raw sum unchanged.

records.name: The record filter reducer that keeps only a negative total
records.purpose: Reports the selection's total only when it is a credit total, and reports nothing otherwise, which is the mirror of the reducer that keeps only a positive total.

operands.name: the matching Journal Items
operands.unit_or_currency: items carrying amounts in the presentation currency
operands.source: the ledger, restricted by the base restriction, by the date window of the expression's date scope and by the formula's own condition
operands.constraints: an item enters at most once

operands.name: debit of each matching item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: not negative

operands.name: credit of each matching item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: not negative

preconditions.condition: The formula parses as a literal record filter, with no function call, no variable and no arithmetic.
preconditions.otherwise: The formula is refused at write time with the formula error of the expression rules.

preconditions.condition: The expression carries a subformula, which is mandatory for this engine.
preconditions.otherwise: The record is refused by the stored check that requires a record filter expression to carry a subformula.

procedure: Compute the raw sum of the selection.
When the raw sum is lower than zero, the reducer result is the raw sum.
When the raw sum is zero or more, the reducer result is zero.
Apply the leading minus of the subformula afterwards, when there is one.
records.formula:
reducer_result = raw_sum    when raw_sum < 0
reducer_result = 0          when raw_sum ≥ 0

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and then the whole unit when the report sets an integer rounding mode.
rounding.step: At display, after the reducer and after any leading minus.

result.name: figure of the expression
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell of the line and of the column bound to the expression's label.

edge_cases.case: The raw sum is exactly zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The result is zero, because the test is strictly lower than zero.

edge_cases.case: The subformula carries a leading minus.
edge_cases.outcome: The negation is applied after the reducer, so a credit total is reported as a positive figure.

edge_cases.case: No item matches.
edge_cases.outcome: The raw sum is zero and the result is zero.

worked_examples.description: The selection of the worked example, whose raw sum is negative
worked_examples.narrative: Minus sixteen thousand two hundred is lower than zero, so the reducer returns the raw sum unchanged.

worked_examples.description: The same selection with a leading minus on the subformula
worked_examples.narrative: The reducer returns minus sixteen thousand two hundred and the leading minus turns it into sixteen thousand two hundred.

records.name: The record filter reducer that counts rows
records.purpose: Reports how many rows the expression would produce rather than their total, which is how a declaration that asks for a number of recipients or a number of documents is filled.

operands.name: the matching Journal Items
operands.unit_or_currency: items carrying amounts in the presentation currency
operands.source: the ledger, restricted by the base restriction, by the date window of the expression's date scope and by the formula's own condition
operands.constraints: an item enters at most once

operands.name: debit of each matching item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: not negative

operands.name: credit of each matching item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: not negative

operands.name: the grouping key of the line
operands.unit_or_currency: a list of field names, possibly empty
operands.source: the report line
operands.constraints: when present, the count is over distinct combinations of those fields

preconditions.condition: The formula parses as a literal record filter, with no function call, no variable and no arithmetic.
preconditions.otherwise: The formula is refused at write time with the formula error of the expression rules.

preconditions.condition: The expression carries a subformula, which is mandatory for this engine.
preconditions.otherwise: The record is refused by the stored check that requires a record filter expression to carry a subformula.

procedure: Take the Journal Items that satisfy the base restriction, the date window and the formula's condition.
When the line carries a grouping key, count the distinct combinations of the grouping key's field values among those items.
When the line carries no grouping key, count the items themselves.
Apply the leading minus of the subformula afterwards, when there is one.
records.formula:
reducer_result = number of distinct grouping key combinations among the matching items    when the line has a grouping key
reducer_result = number of matching items                                                  otherwise

rounding.precision: A whole number; no decimal places.
rounding.method: Not applicable: a count is already whole.
rounding.step: No rounding step.

result.name: count of rows
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell; the drill-down still lists the items themselves, even though the figure counts them.

edge_cases.case: No item matches.
edge_cases.outcome: The count is zero, not empty.

edge_cases.case: The line has a grouping key naming two fields.
edge_cases.outcome: The count is the number of distinct pairs of values, not the number of items.

edge_cases.case: The subformula carries a leading minus.
edge_cases.outcome: The count is negated, which is an authoring choice and not a meaningful declaration figure.

worked_examples.description: A withholding line counting the recipients of withholding in a quarter
worked_examples.narrative: The line has no grouping key, so the eleven matching items give eleven, and the drill-down lists those eleven items.

records.name: The leading minus of a record filter subformula
records.purpose: Flips the sign of a record filter figure after the reducer has run, which is what lets a credit total be declared as a positive amount without changing the ledger.

operands.name: reducer result
operands.unit_or_currency: the presentation currency, or a count for the reducer that counts rows
operands.source: the reducer named by the subformula
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: leading minus
operands.source: the first character of the subformula
operands.constraints: present or absent

preconditions.condition: The subformula parses as an optional minus followed by one of the four reducer names.
preconditions.otherwise: The formula is refused at write time with the formula error of the expression rules.

procedure: Apply the reducer named by the subformula to the raw sum.
When the subformula begins with a minus, multiply the reducer result by minus one.
Otherwise keep the reducer result as it stands.
records.formula:
result = −1 × reducer_result    when the subformula starts with a minus
result =      reducer_result    otherwise

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded by the sign step.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: The sign is applied after the reducer and before any presentation rounding.

result.name: figure of the expression
result.unit_or_currency: the presentation currency, or a count
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell of the line and of the column bound to the expression's label.

edge_cases.case: The minus is combined with the reducer that keeps only a positive total.
edge_cases.outcome: The expression returns zero when the raw sum is negative and a negative figure when it is positive; it never returns a positive number.

edge_cases.case: The minus is combined with the reducer that counts rows.
edge_cases.outcome: The count is negated.

edge_cases.case: The reducer result is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The negation leaves zero; a minus zero is never displayed.

worked_examples.description: The taxable turnover line of the worked example, with the subformula that sums and negates
worked_examples.narrative: The reducer returns minus sixteen thousand two hundred; minus one times that figure is sixteen thousand two hundred, which is what the line displays, and the drill-down lists the three contributing items.

records.name: The tag total of the tax tag engine
records.purpose: Connects a report line to the taxes that feed it without the report knowing any account code: the tax stamps a tag on the items it generates and the line receives the balance of every item carrying that tag.

operands.name: the tag the formula matches
operands.source: the tag whose name equals the formula with any leading minus removed, whose applicability is taxes, and whose country is the country of the report the expression's line belongs to
operands.constraints: exactly one tag matches; the match is made on the English text of the name and ignores the tag's active flag

operands.name: the items carrying that tag
operands.unit_or_currency: items carrying amounts in the presentation currency
operands.source: the ledger, restricted by the base restriction and by the date window of the expression's date scope
operands.constraints: an item carrying several tags contributes its whole balance to each of them

preconditions.condition: The report the line belongs to declares a country.
preconditions.otherwise: The tag is matched with an empty country and then matches only items whose tag also has an empty country; a report using this engine should always declare a country.

preconditions.condition: Exactly one tag bears the formula's name for that country and applicability.
preconditions.otherwise: The uniqueness rule of the tags is violated and the match is ambiguous; a rebuild must never create a pair of plus-named and minus-named tags.

procedure: Normalize the formula by collapsing runs of whitespace to single spaces and trimming it.
Remove a leading minus, when present, to obtain the tag name.
Find the single tag of that name whose applicability is taxes and whose country is the report's country.
Take the Journal Items that satisfy the base restriction, that fall in the date window of the expression's date scope, and that carry that tag.
Add the debit and subtract the credit of every such item, accumulating at full stored precision.
records.formula: tag_sum = Σ over items m carrying the tag of ( debit(m) − credit(m) )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and then the whole unit when the report sets an integer rounding mode.
rounding.step: Only at display; the sum is accumulated at full stored precision.

result.name: tag total
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell when the formula carries no leading minus; otherwise it is the input of the negation.

edge_cases.case: The tag is archived.
edge_cases.outcome: It is still matched and its items are still counted: archival hides a tag from pickers, not from history.

edge_cases.case: One item carries several tags.
edge_cases.outcome: Its whole balance contributes to each of them; tags are not shares.

edge_cases.case: No item carries the tag.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is zero, not empty.

edge_cases.case: The tax is a payment-basis tax and the only-tax-exigible flag is on.
edge_cases.outcome: The item enters only once its cash-basis entry exists, and that entry carries the same tags, which is why the third exigibility test admits it unconditionally.

worked_examples.description: A deductible tax box of a national return in a quarter with two purchase tax items
worked_examples.narrative: Two thousand minus zero, plus zero minus three hundred, gives one thousand seven hundred, which the box shows as it stands because input tax sits on the debit side.

records.name: The negated tag total of the tax tag engine
records.purpose: Turns a credit tag total into the positive figure an output tax box must declare, using the leading minus of the formula as a sign instruction on the expression rather than as part of the tag's name.

operands.name: the tag the formula matches
operands.source: the tag whose name equals the formula with any leading minus removed, whose applicability is taxes, and whose country is the country of the report the expression's line belongs to
operands.constraints: exactly one tag matches; the match is made on the English text of the name and ignores the tag's active flag

operands.name: the items carrying that tag
operands.unit_or_currency: items carrying amounts in the presentation currency
operands.source: the ledger, restricted by the base restriction and by the date window of the expression's date scope
operands.constraints: an item carrying several tags contributes its whole balance to each of them

operands.name: leading minus
operands.source: the first character of the formula
operands.constraints: a sign instruction on the expression, never part of the tag name

preconditions.condition: The report the line belongs to declares a country.
preconditions.otherwise: The tag is matched with an empty country and then matches only items whose tag also has an empty country; a report using this engine should always declare a country.

preconditions.condition: Exactly one tag bears the formula's name for that country and applicability.
preconditions.otherwise: The uniqueness rule of the tags is violated and the match is ambiguous; a rebuild must never create a pair of plus-named and minus-named tags.

procedure: Compute the tag total exactly as for a formula without a minus, using the same tag.
Multiply the tag total by minus one.
records.formula:
result = −1 × tag_sum    when the formula starts with a minus
result =      tag_sum    otherwise

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded by the sign step.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency at display.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, at display.
rounding.step: The sign is applied to the accumulated total before any presentation rounding.

result.name: figure of the box
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell of the line and of the column bound to the expression's label.

edge_cases.case: Two expressions of the same country use the formulas of a name and of that name with a leading minus.
edge_cases.outcome: They point at the same tag and report opposite figures; a rebuild must never create a signed pair of tags.

edge_cases.case: A credit note uses the refund repartition set.
edge_cases.outcome: A country that wants refunds to subtract from the same box puts the same tag on both repartition sets and relies on the ledger sign; a country that wants a separate box puts a different tag on the refund set.

edge_cases.case: The tag total is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The negation leaves zero and a minus zero is never displayed.

worked_examples.description: A standard-rated sales line whose base and tax boxes both carry a leading minus, over one invoice and one credit note
worked_examples.narrative: The base items give zero minus ten thousand plus one thousand five hundred minus zero, that is minus eight thousand five hundred, which the minus turns into eight thousand five hundred; the tax items give minus one thousand seven hundred, which the minus turns into one thousand seven hundred, exactly twenty percent of the declared net.

records.name: The arithmetic of an aggregation formula
records.purpose: Performs arithmetic on figures other expressions have already produced, which is how every subtotal, every result line and every derived rate of a report is obtained without touching the ledger a second time.

operands.name: the resolved references
operands.source: the figures already computed for the referenced expressions, for the same period column
operands.constraints: a reference that resolves to an expression which produced no figure contributes zero

operands.name: the numeric literals of the formula
operands.source: the formula itself
operands.constraints: written with an optional sign, digits, an optional decimal part and an optional power-of-ten exponent

operands.name: the operators
operands.source: the formula itself
operands.constraints: a space between two operands is itself an operator and has no defined meaning

preconditions.condition: The formula matches the aggregation grammar from its first character to its last.
preconditions.otherwise: The write is refused with the message that reproduces the invalid formula for the named expression label of the named line, followed by the formula.

preconditions.condition: Every reference names a line code and an expression label that exist in the report, or in the report named by a cross-report clause.
preconditions.otherwise: The expression cannot be evaluated: the cell is rendered empty and the condition is reported to the designer.

preconditions.condition: The dependency graph of the referenced expressions has no cycle.
preconditions.otherwise: Evaluation stops and reports that the aggregation formulas of this report form a cycle through the named line code.

procedure: Resolve every reference of the shape line code, a period and an expression label to the figure already computed for that expression on that line, in the same report or in the report named by a cross-report clause, for the same period column.
Treat a reference that resolves to an expression which produced no figure as zero, and treat a reference that resolves to no expression at all as an authoring error.
Evaluate multiplications and divisions before additions and subtractions, left to right within a level of precedence, and parentheses first.
Apply the clauses of the subformula to the value obtained, in the order given by the bound clause rules.
records.formula:
raw_value = the arithmetic of the formula over the resolved references and the numeric literals,
            with × and ÷ evaluated before + and −, left to right within a level, parentheses first

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded during the arithmetic.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency at display, or the number of decimals of a rounding clause when the subformula carries one.
rounding.step: Only after the arithmetic and the bound clauses, at display.

result.name: figure of the aggregation
result.unit_or_currency: the presentation currency, or a plain number for a ratio
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell of the line and of the column bound to the expression's label, and readable by any further aggregation.

edge_cases.case: A formula places two operands side by side separated only by a space.
edge_cases.outcome: It matches the grammar but has no defined meaning and must be rejected at evaluation: multiplication is not implied.

edge_cases.case: A parenthesis is unbalanced.
edge_cases.outcome: The grammar does not check the balance, but the arithmetic becomes un-evaluable and it is an authoring error.

edge_cases.case: A referenced line was filtered out of the rendering.
edge_cases.outcome: Its expression produced no figure and the reference contributes zero.

edge_cases.case: The formula multiplies or divides.
edge_cases.outcome: The drill-down shows the contributing sets but cannot attribute the product to individual items, so the figure is presented as derived rather than as a sum of items.

worked_examples.description: A total line adding the tax figures of two lines of the return of the United Arab Emirates
worked_examples.narrative: Three thousand two hundred and fifty plus eight hundred and fifteen point five zero is four thousand and sixty-five point five zero.

worked_examples.description: A line applying a rate of five percent to the base of another line
worked_examples.narrative: Sixty-four thousand times five hundredths is three thousand two hundred, which is the tax the declaration derives from a base typed by hand.

records.name: The division by zero of an aggregation formula
records.purpose: Fixes what a ratio shows when its denominator is zero, so that an empty period produces either a deliberate zero or an empty cell rather than an undefined figure.

operands.name: numerator
operands.source: a resolved reference or a literal
operands.constraints: any value

operands.name: denominator
operands.source: a resolved reference or a literal
operands.constraints: the case handled here is a denominator of exactly zero

operands.name: the clause that ignores a division by zero
operands.source: the subformula of the expression
operands.constraints: present or absent

preconditions.condition: The formula matches the aggregation grammar from its first character to its last.
preconditions.otherwise: The write is refused with the message that reproduces the invalid formula for the named expression label of the named line, followed by the formula.

preconditions.condition: Every reference names a line code and an expression label that exist in the report, or in the report named by a cross-report clause.
preconditions.otherwise: The expression cannot be evaluated: the cell is rendered empty and the condition is reported to the designer.

preconditions.condition: The dependency graph of the referenced expressions has no cycle.
preconditions.otherwise: Evaluation stops and reports that the aggregation formulas of this report form a cycle through the named line code.

procedure: Resolve the references and evaluate the arithmetic.
When a division has a denominator of exactly zero and the subformula carries the clause that ignores a division by zero, the whole expression yields zero.
When a division has a denominator of exactly zero and that clause is absent, the figure is undefined and the cell is rendered empty.
records.formula:
raw_value = 0        when a denominator is zero and the clause that ignores a division by zero is present
raw_value = undefined, and the cell is rendered empty, when a denominator is zero and that clause is absent

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded: no figure is produced when the cell is left empty.
rounding.precision: Not applicable.
rounding.step: Not applicable.

result.name: figure of the aggregation, or an empty cell
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed as a zero or left empty; the difference is meaningful, because a zero says the calculation ran and an empty cell says it could not.

edge_cases.case: Every ratio line of the summary statement of the executive.
edge_cases.outcome: Each carries the clause that ignores a division by zero, so an empty period shows zero rather than an empty cell.

edge_cases.case: The numerator is also zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The rule is unchanged: the clause decides between a zero and an empty cell.

edge_cases.case: The denominator is very small but not zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The division is performed normally and may produce a very large figure; only an exact zero triggers this rule.

worked_examples.description: A gross profit margin in a period with no income and the clause that ignores a division by zero
worked_examples.narrative: The denominator is zero and the clause is present, so the whole expression yields zero instead of an undefined figure.

worked_examples.description: The same ratio without that clause
worked_examples.narrative: The denominator is zero and no clause covers it, so the cell is rendered empty.

records.name: The sum over the direct children of a line
records.purpose: Gives a heading line the total of the lines beneath it without naming them, so that adding a child line to a definition changes the heading's figure with no other edit.

operands.name: the direct child lines
operands.source: the line tree of the report definition
operands.constraints: grandchildren are excluded

operands.name: the figure of each child for this expression's label
operands.source: the expression of the child whose label equals this expression's label
operands.constraints: a child with no expression of that label contributes zero

preconditions.condition: The formula is exactly the name of the sum over children and nothing else.
preconditions.otherwise: The formula is parsed as arithmetic instead, and a bare name that is not a reference fails the grammar.

preconditions.condition: The line has at least one child.
preconditions.otherwise: The sum is zero, because a sum over an empty set of children is zero.

procedure: Take the direct children of the line, in definition order.
For each child, read the figure of its expression whose label equals this expression's label, and take zero when the child has no such expression.
Add those figures at full stored precision.
Do not descend to grandchildren: they contribute only through their own parent's sum over children, when that parent has one.
records.formula:
raw_value = Σ over the direct children c of this line
              of ( the figure of the expression of c whose label equals this expression's label )

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded during the sum.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency at display.
rounding.step: Only at display; the children's unrounded figures are added.

result.name: figure of the heading line
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the heading line and readable by any further aggregation.

edge_cases.case: A child has no expression of the label.
edge_cases.outcome: It contributes zero.

edge_cases.case: A child is hidden by the hide-if-zero rule.
edge_cases.outcome: Its figure was zero after rounding, so its contribution to the parent is immaterial; the parent is itself hidden when all of its descendants are hidden and the report-level hide-zero option is on.

edge_cases.case: A grandchild carries a figure but its parent has no sum over children.
edge_cases.outcome: The grandchild contributes nothing to the top line, which is an authoring choice and not an error.

worked_examples.description: A heading line for the total of the current assets over three child lines
worked_examples.narrative: Eighteen thousand four hundred plus fifty-two thousand three hundred plus one thousand two hundred and fifty is seventy-one thousand nine hundred and fifty.

records.name: The conversion of a bound of a subformula clause
records.purpose: Expresses a bound written in one currency in the presentation currency of the report, so that a threshold written by a national definition keeps its legal meaning when the report is rendered for a company of another currency.

operands.name: the bound as written
operands.unit_or_currency: the three-letter code of a currency in capital letters, followed by the amount in parentheses
operands.source: the subformula of the expression
operands.constraints: the literal code that stands for the presentation currency means the bound is already expressed in it

operands.name: the rate in force at the report's to-date
operands.source: the currency rates of the multi-currency documents
operands.constraints: the rate of the day of the report's to-date

preconditions.condition: A rate exists between the bound's currency and the presentation currency at the report's to-date.
preconditions.otherwise: The conversion cannot be made and the bound cannot be applied; the multi-currency documents specify the fallback to the most recent earlier rate.

procedure: Read the three-letter currency code and the amount of the bound.
When the code is the literal one that stands for the presentation currency, take the amount as it stands.
Otherwise convert the amount from the bound's currency into the presentation currency at the rate in force on the report's to-date.
Apply the converted bound in the clause's test.
records.formula:
converted_bound = bound_amount × rate( bound_currency → presentation_currency , report_date_to )
converted_bound = bound_amount    when the bound's currency code stands for the presentation currency

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency.
rounding.step: Before the bound test, so that the comparison is made between two amounts of the same currency.

result.name: bound in the presentation currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Not displayed; it is the threshold the clause compares the raw value against.

edge_cases.case: The bound is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The conversion leaves zero whatever the rate, so a floor at zero is currency-independent.

edge_cases.case: The presentation currency is the bound's currency.
edge_cases.outcome: The rate is one and the amount is unchanged.

edge_cases.case: Several companies of different currencies are selected.
edge_cases.outcome: The presentation currency is the currency of the first selected company, and the bound is converted into it.

worked_examples.description: A clamp written in Canadian dollars applied to a report presented in Canadian dollars
worked_examples.narrative: The bound's currency is the presentation currency, so the rate is one and the bound stays at fifty-eight.

worked_examples.description: A floor of zero written in euros applied to a report presented in another currency
worked_examples.narrative: Zero times any rate is zero, so a floor at zero is the same threshold in every currency.

records.name: The clause that keeps a value only above a bound
records.purpose: Floors a figure at zero when it does not exceed a bound, which is how the box that says what must be paid is kept empty in a period where nothing is owed.

operands.name: raw value
operands.source: the arithmetic of the aggregation formula
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: bound
operands.source: the clause of the subformula
operands.constraints: any amount, most often zero

preconditions.condition: The formula matches the aggregation grammar from its first character to its last.
preconditions.otherwise: The write is refused with the message that reproduces the invalid formula for the named expression label of the named line, followed by the formula.

preconditions.condition: Every reference names a line code and an expression label that exist in the report, or in the report named by a cross-report clause.
preconditions.otherwise: The expression cannot be evaluated: the cell is rendered empty and the condition is reported to the designer.

preconditions.condition: The dependency graph of the referenced expressions has no cycle.
preconditions.otherwise: Evaluation stops and reports that the aggregation formulas of this report form a cycle through the named line code.

procedure: Evaluate the arithmetic of the formula to obtain the raw value.
Convert the bound of the clause into the presentation currency.
When the raw value is strictly greater than the bound, keep the raw value.
Otherwise return zero.
records.formula:
result = raw_value    when raw_value > bound
result = 0            when raw_value ≤ bound

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and the number of decimals of a rounding clause when one follows.
rounding.step: After the bound test, at display.

result.name: figure of the box
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell; it is the amount the declaration asks to be paid, or the positive side of a split net position.

edge_cases.case: The raw value equals the bound exactly.
edge_cases.outcome: The result is zero, because the test is strictly greater than.

edge_cases.case: The complementary line uses the clause that keeps a value only below the bound with a negation.
edge_cases.outcome: Exactly one of the two lines is non-zero and the other carries the whole position.

edge_cases.case: The clause is combined with a rounding clause.
edge_cases.outcome: The bound test runs first and the rounding second.

worked_examples.description: A net position carried forward only when it is positive
worked_examples.narrative: Twelve thousand four hundred minus nine thousand one hundred is three thousand three hundred, which is above zero, so the box shows three thousand three hundred.

worked_examples.description: The same line in a period where the position is negative
worked_examples.narrative: Nine thousand one hundred minus twelve thousand four hundred is minus three thousand three hundred, which is not above zero, so the box shows zero.

records.name: The clause that keeps a value only below a bound
records.purpose: Keeps a figure only when it falls under a bound, which is how the amount to be carried to the next period is isolated from the amount that is declared now.

operands.name: raw value
operands.source: the arithmetic of the aggregation formula
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: bound
operands.source: the clause of the subformula
operands.constraints: any amount, most often zero

preconditions.condition: The formula matches the aggregation grammar from its first character to its last.
preconditions.otherwise: The write is refused with the message that reproduces the invalid formula for the named expression label of the named line, followed by the formula.

preconditions.condition: Every reference names a line code and an expression label that exist in the report, or in the report named by a cross-report clause.
preconditions.otherwise: The expression cannot be evaluated: the cell is rendered empty and the condition is reported to the designer.

preconditions.condition: The dependency graph of the referenced expressions has no cycle.
preconditions.otherwise: Evaluation stops and reports that the aggregation formulas of this report form a cycle through the named line code.

procedure: Evaluate the arithmetic of the formula to obtain the raw value.
Convert the bound of the clause into the presentation currency.
When the raw value is strictly lower than the bound, keep the raw value.
Otherwise return zero.
records.formula:
result = raw_value    when raw_value < bound
result = 0            when raw_value ≥ bound

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and the number of decimals of a rounding clause when one follows.
rounding.step: After the bound test, at display.

result.name: figure of the carrying expression
result.stored_or_displayed: Not usually displayed: it is the amount written to an external value when the period is closed.

edge_cases.case: The raw value equals the bound exactly.
edge_cases.outcome: The result is zero, because the test is strictly lower than.

edge_cases.case: The clause is used on a carry-out expression with a bound of zero.
edge_cases.outcome: Only a negative position is carried out, and the declared box, floored by the complementary clause, shows zero in that period.

edge_cases.case: The clause is used together with the clause that keeps a value only above the same bound on two lines.
edge_cases.outcome: Exactly one of the two is non-zero in any period.

worked_examples.description: A carry-out expression over a negative position
worked_examples.narrative: Minus four hundred and twenty is below zero, so the whole negative position is carried out.

worked_examples.description: The same expression over a positive position
worked_examples.narrative: Seven hundred and ten is not below zero, so nothing is carried out.

records.name: The clause that clamps a value between two bounds
records.purpose: Caps a figure at a legal maximum and floors it at a legal minimum, keeping the boundary value rather than zeroing the cell, which is how a capped credit is declared.

operands.name: raw value
operands.source: the arithmetic of the aggregation formula
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: lower bound
operands.source: the first bound of the clause
operands.constraints: any amount

operands.name: upper bound
operands.source: the second bound of the clause
operands.constraints: any amount, normally greater than the lower bound

preconditions.condition: The formula matches the aggregation grammar from its first character to its last.
preconditions.otherwise: The write is refused with the message that reproduces the invalid formula for the named expression label of the named line, followed by the formula.

preconditions.condition: Every reference names a line code and an expression label that exist in the report, or in the report named by a cross-report clause.
preconditions.otherwise: The expression cannot be evaluated: the cell is rendered empty and the condition is reported to the designer.

preconditions.condition: The dependency graph of the referenced expressions has no cycle.
preconditions.otherwise: Evaluation stops and reports that the aggregation formulas of this report form a cycle through the named line code.

procedure: Evaluate the arithmetic of the formula to obtain the raw value.
Convert both bounds into the presentation currency.
When the raw value lies strictly between the two bounds, keep it.
When the raw value is at or below the lower bound, return the lower bound.
When the raw value is at or above the upper bound, return the upper bound.
records.formula:
result = raw_value      when lower_bound < raw_value < upper_bound
result = lower_bound    when raw_value ≤ lower_bound
result = upper_bound    when raw_value ≥ upper_bound

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and the number of decimals of a rounding clause when one follows.
rounding.step: After the clamp, at display.

result.name: clamped figure
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell, or written as a carry-over amount when the clause sits on a carry-out expression.

edge_cases.case: The value is clamped, not zeroed.
edge_cases.outcome: This is the difference with the two single-bound clauses: a value beyond a bound returns the bound itself.

edge_cases.case: The value equals a bound exactly.
edge_cases.outcome: The bound is returned, because both tests are inclusive at the bounds.

edge_cases.case: The lower bound is greater than the upper bound.
edge_cases.outcome: The two inclusive tests overlap and the lower bound wins, which is an authoring error rather than a defined behaviour.

worked_examples.description: A capped credit of forty-two within the range from zero to fifty-eight
worked_examples.narrative: Forty-two lies strictly between zero and fifty-eight, so it passes unchanged.

worked_examples.description: The same credit at seventy-one
worked_examples.narrative: Seventy-one is at or above the upper bound, so the cap of fifty-eight is returned.

worked_examples.description: The same credit at minus five
worked_examples.narrative: Minus five is at or below the lower bound, so the floor of zero is returned.

records.name: The clause that guards on another expression above a bound
records.purpose: Shows a figure only while another figure exceeds a bound, which keeps the condition and the amount in two separate expressions so that the definition states the legal test explicitly.

operands.name: raw value
operands.source: the arithmetic of this expression's formula
operands.constraints: any value

operands.name: the guarding figure
operands.source: the expression named by the reference inside the clause
operands.constraints: resolved for the same period column

operands.name: bound
operands.source: the second argument of the clause
operands.constraints: any amount

preconditions.condition: The formula matches the aggregation grammar from its first character to its last.
preconditions.otherwise: The write is refused with the message that reproduces the invalid formula for the named expression label of the named line, followed by the formula.

preconditions.condition: Every reference names a line code and an expression label that exist in the report, or in the report named by a cross-report clause.
preconditions.otherwise: The expression cannot be evaluated: the cell is rendered empty and the condition is reported to the designer.

preconditions.condition: The dependency graph of the referenced expressions has no cycle.
preconditions.otherwise: Evaluation stops and reports that the aggregation formulas of this report form a cycle through the named line code.

procedure: Evaluate the arithmetic of this expression to obtain the raw value.
Resolve the reference inside the clause to the figure of the guarding expression, for the same period column.
Convert the bound into the presentation currency.
When the guarding figure is strictly greater than the bound, keep the raw value; otherwise return zero.
records.formula:
result = raw_value    when the figure of the referenced expression > bound
result = 0            otherwise

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and the number of decimals of a rounding clause when one follows.
rounding.step: After the guard test, at display.

result.name: guarded figure
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell of the line and of the column bound to the expression's label.

edge_cases.case: The clause references the same expression it guards.
edge_cases.outcome: The clause becomes equivalent to the floor at that bound, but the definition keeps the two roles explicit.

edge_cases.case: The guarding expression produced no figure.
edge_cases.outcome: The reference contributes zero, so the guard fails unless the bound is negative.

edge_cases.case: The guarding figure equals the bound.
edge_cases.outcome: The result is zero, because the test is strictly greater than.

worked_examples.description: A rounded box shown only while the unrounded box is positive
worked_examples.narrative: The guarding figure of one thousand two hundred and four is above zero, so the rounded box is shown.

worked_examples.description: The same box when the unrounded box is negative
worked_examples.narrative: The guarding figure is not above zero, so the box shows zero.

records.name: The clause that guards on another expression below a bound
records.purpose: Shows a figure only while another figure falls under a bound, which is the mirror of the guard above a bound and is used for the reclaim side of a split position.

operands.name: raw value
operands.source: the arithmetic of this expression's formula
operands.constraints: any value

operands.name: the guarding figure
operands.source: the expression named by the reference inside the clause
operands.constraints: resolved for the same period column

operands.name: bound
operands.source: the second argument of the clause
operands.constraints: any amount

preconditions.condition: The formula matches the aggregation grammar from its first character to its last.
preconditions.otherwise: The write is refused with the message that reproduces the invalid formula for the named expression label of the named line, followed by the formula.

preconditions.condition: Every reference names a line code and an expression label that exist in the report, or in the report named by a cross-report clause.
preconditions.otherwise: The expression cannot be evaluated: the cell is rendered empty and the condition is reported to the designer.

preconditions.condition: The dependency graph of the referenced expressions has no cycle.
preconditions.otherwise: Evaluation stops and reports that the aggregation formulas of this report form a cycle through the named line code.

procedure: Evaluate the arithmetic of this expression to obtain the raw value.
Resolve the reference inside the clause to the figure of the guarding expression, for the same period column.
Convert the bound into the presentation currency.
When the guarding figure is strictly lower than the bound, keep the raw value; otherwise return zero.
records.formula:
result = raw_value    when the figure of the referenced expression < bound
result = 0            otherwise

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and the number of decimals of a rounding clause when one follows.
rounding.step: After the guard test, at display.

result.name: guarded figure
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell of the line and of the column bound to the expression's label.

edge_cases.case: The guarding figure equals the bound.
edge_cases.outcome: The result is zero, because the test is strictly lower than.

edge_cases.case: The guarding expression produced no figure.
edge_cases.outcome: The reference contributes zero, so the guard succeeds when the bound is positive.

edge_cases.case: The clause references the same expression it guards.
edge_cases.outcome: The clause becomes equivalent to keeping the value only below that bound.

worked_examples.description: A reclaim box shown only while the net position is negative
worked_examples.narrative: The guarding figure of minus three thousand three hundred is below zero, so the reclaim box shows three thousand three hundred.

worked_examples.description: The same box while the net position is positive
worked_examples.narrative: The guarding figure is not below zero, so the reclaim box shows zero.

records.name: The rounding clause of an aggregation subformula
records.purpose: Rounds an aggregation figure to a fixed number of decimal places, which is how a legislation that declares whole amounts is served without changing the presentation currency of the report.

operands.name: raw value
operands.source: the arithmetic of the formula, after any bound clause
operands.constraints: any value

operands.name: number of decimal places
operands.source: the digits inside the rounding clause
operands.constraints: not negative; zero means a whole number

preconditions.condition: The formula matches the aggregation grammar from its first character to its last.
preconditions.otherwise: The write is refused with the message that reproduces the invalid formula for the named expression label of the named line, followed by the formula.

preconditions.condition: Every reference names a line code and an expression label that exist in the report, or in the report named by a cross-report clause.
preconditions.otherwise: The expression cannot be evaluated: the cell is rendered empty and the condition is reported to the designer.

preconditions.condition: The dependency graph of the referenced expressions has no cycle.
preconditions.otherwise: Evaluation stops and reports that the aggregation formulas of this report form a cycle through the named line code.

procedure: Evaluate the arithmetic and apply any bound clause first.
Read the number of decimal places from the rounding clause.
Round the value to that many decimal places, carrying a half away from zero.
records.formula:
rounded_value = sign( raw_value ) × floor( | raw_value | × 10ⁿ + 0.5 ) ÷ 10ⁿ
                where n is the number of decimal places of the clause

rounding.precision: The number of decimal places named by the clause; zero gives a whole number.
rounding.step: After the arithmetic and after any bound clause, and before the report's whole-unit rounding and the presentation rounding unit.

result.name: rounded figure
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell, and read as a rounded operand by the totals that a legislation requires to equal the sum of the declared boxes.

edge_cases.case: The division produces an exact whole number.
edge_cases.outcome: The rounding leaves it unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The value is exactly on a half.
edge_cases.outcome: The half is carried away from zero, so one and five thousandths rounded to two decimals is one and one hundredth, and minus one and five thousandths is minus one and one hundredth.

edge_cases.case: Ninety shipped expressions carry the label for a rounded balance.
edge_cases.outcome: They exist so that a total may aggregate rounded boxes rather than raw ones, as a legislation may require.

worked_examples.description: A one-eleventh extraction of a balance that divides exactly
