worked_examples.narrative: The whole-unit rounding gives one million two hundred and thirty-four thousand five hundred and sixty-eight, which divided by one thousand and rendered with one decimal is one thousand two hundred and thirty-four point six.

records.name: Whole-unit rounding in the mode that carries a half away from zero
records.purpose: Rounds a figure to the nearest whole unit of the presentation currency, carrying a tie away from zero, which is the mode most legislations that declare whole amounts require.

operands.name: the value
operands.source: the figure after any expression-level rounding clause
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

preconditions.condition: The report sets a whole-unit rounding mode.
preconditions.otherwise: No whole-unit rounding is applied and the figure keeps the decimal places of the presentation currency.

procedure: Take the absolute value of the figure and remember its sign.
Add one half and take the whole part downwards.
Restore the remembered sign.
records.formula: value_rounded = sign( value ) × floor( | value | + 0.5 )

rounding.precision: Whole units of the presentation currency.
rounding.step: After any expression-level rounding clause and before the presentation rounding unit.

result.name: rounded figure
result.unit_or_currency: whole units of the presentation currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell and read by any total that aggregates rounded expressions.

edge_cases.case: The value is exactly on a half.
edge_cases.outcome: The half is carried away from zero, so ten and a half becomes eleven and minus ten and a half becomes minus eleven.

edge_cases.case: The value is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The result is zero.

edge_cases.case: A column of three lines at ten point four each.
edge_cases.outcome: Each displays ten and their total, computed unrounded, displays thirty-one.

worked_examples.description: Three values rounded in this mode
worked_examples.narrative: Ten point four rounds down to ten; ten point five is a tie and is carried away from zero to eleven; minus ten point five is carried away from zero to minus eleven.

records.name: Whole-unit rounding in the mode that always rounds away from zero
records.purpose: Rounds a figure to the next whole unit away from zero whatever its fractional part, which a legislation uses where a declaration must never understate an amount.

operands.name: the value
operands.source: the figure after any expression-level rounding clause
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

preconditions.condition: The report sets this whole-unit rounding mode.
preconditions.otherwise: One of the other two modes applies, or no whole-unit rounding at all.

procedure: Take the absolute value of the figure and remember its sign.
Take the whole part upwards, that is round up to the next whole unit unless the value is already whole.
Restore the remembered sign.
records.formula: value_rounded = sign( value ) × ceiling( | value | )

rounding.precision: Whole units of the presentation currency.
rounding.step: After any expression-level rounding clause and before the presentation rounding unit.

result.name: rounded figure
result.unit_or_currency: whole units of the presentation currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell.

edge_cases.case: The value is already whole.
edge_cases.outcome: It is unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The value is a small positive fraction.
edge_cases.outcome: It becomes one.

edge_cases.case: The value is a small negative fraction.
edge_cases.outcome: It becomes minus one, because the rounding is away from zero and not upwards on the number line.

worked_examples.description: Three values rounded in this mode
worked_examples.narrative: Ten point one becomes eleven, minus ten point one becomes minus eleven, and a value already whole is unchanged.

records.name: Whole-unit rounding in the mode that always rounds towards zero
records.purpose: Drops the fractional part of a figure whatever its size, which a legislation uses where a declaration must never overstate an amount.

operands.name: the value
operands.source: the figure after any expression-level rounding clause
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

preconditions.condition: The report sets this whole-unit rounding mode.
preconditions.otherwise: One of the other two modes applies, or no whole-unit rounding at all.

procedure: Take the absolute value of the figure and remember its sign.
Take the whole part downwards, dropping the fractional part.
Restore the remembered sign.
records.formula: value_rounded = sign( value ) × floor( | value | )

rounding.precision: Whole units of the presentation currency.
rounding.step: After any expression-level rounding clause and before the presentation rounding unit.

result.name: rounded figure
result.unit_or_currency: whole units of the presentation currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell.

edge_cases.case: The value is already whole.
edge_cases.outcome: It is unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The value is a large positive fraction.
edge_cases.outcome: The fractional part is dropped, so ten point nine becomes ten.

edge_cases.case: The value is a negative fraction.
edge_cases.outcome: It becomes zero, because the rounding is towards zero and not downwards on the number line.

worked_examples.description: Three values rounded in this mode
worked_examples.narrative: Ten point nine becomes ten, minus ten point nine becomes minus ten, and a small negative fraction becomes zero.

records.name: The presentation rounding unit
records.purpose: Scales every figure of a rendering to units, thousands or millions, so that a very large statement can be read at a glance.

operands.name: the rounded value
operands.source: the figure after the expression-level and report-level rounding
operands.constraints: any value

operands.name: the rounding unit
operands.source: the user options
operands.constraints: one of the three

preconditions.condition: The reader chose a rounding unit.
preconditions.otherwise: Units are used, which is the scale of one.

procedure: Read the rounding unit the reader chose.
Take the scale: one for units, one thousand for thousands and one million for millions.
Divide the rounded value by the scale.
Render with the decimal places of the presentation currency for units, and with one decimal for thousands and millions.
records.formula:
displayed = value_rounded ÷ scale
scale = 1 for units, 1 000 for thousands, 1 000 000 for millions

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency for units, and one decimal for thousands and millions.
rounding.step: Last of the numeric steps, after the report's whole-unit rounding and before formatting.

result.name: displayed figure
result.unit_or_currency: the presentation currency, expressed in units, thousands or millions
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cell, with the currency symbol and the reader's separators.

edge_cases.case: The unit is units.
edge_cases.outcome: The scale is one and the figure is unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The unit is thousands.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is divided by one thousand and rendered with one decimal.

edge_cases.case: The unit is millions.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is divided by one million and rendered with one decimal.

edge_cases.case: A figure smaller than the scale.
edge_cases.outcome: It renders as zero point zero or as a small fraction of the unit, which is the intended loss of detail.

worked_examples.description: A figure of four hundred and twelve thousand three hundred rendered in each of the three units
worked_examples.narrative: Divided by one, by one thousand and by one million, the figure reads four hundred and twelve thousand three hundred, four hundred and twelve point three and nought point four.

records.name: Rounding half away from zero
records.purpose: Defines the one rounding rule the whole domain uses, so that two independent rebuilds produce the same last decimal on every figure they display.

operands.name: the value
operands.source: the figure to be rounded
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: the number of decimal places
operands.source: the presentation currency, a rounding clause, or the growth rule
operands.constraints: not negative

preconditions.condition: The number of decimal places is known.
preconditions.otherwise: The decimal places of the presentation currency are used.

procedure: Take the absolute value of the figure and remember its sign.
Multiply it by ten raised to the number of decimal places.
Add one half and take the whole part downwards.
Divide by ten raised to the number of decimal places.
Restore the remembered sign.
records.formula: round_half_away_from_zero( x , n ) = sign( x ) × floor( | x | × 10ⁿ + 0.5 ) ÷ 10ⁿ

rounding.precision: The number of decimal places given.
rounding.method: Half away from zero, which is the same rule the ledger uses.
rounding.step: Wherever a rounding step is named: at display, at an expression's rounding clause, at the growth percentage and before a value is stored.

result.name: rounded value
result.unit_or_currency: the unit of the value being rounded
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed, or stored when the rounding precedes a write.

edge_cases.case: The value is exactly on a half.
edge_cases.outcome: The half is carried away from zero: one and five thousandths with two decimals becomes one and one hundredth, and minus one and five thousandths becomes minus one and one hundredth.

edge_cases.case: The value is just below a half.
edge_cases.outcome: It rounds towards zero: two point six seven four nine nine nine with two decimals becomes two point six seven.

edge_cases.case: The value is a small negative fraction.
edge_cases.outcome: Minus five thousandths with two decimals becomes minus one hundredth.

edge_cases.case: The number of decimal places is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The result is a whole number.

worked_examples.description: Four values rounded to two decimal places
worked_examples.narrative: One point zero zero five becomes one point zero one, its negative becomes minus one point zero one, two point six seven four nine nine nine stays at two point six seven, and minus five thousandths becomes minus one hundredth.

records.name: Why a total differs from the sum of the displayed lines
records.purpose: States, as a rule a rebuild must reproduce rather than a defect to fix, that a total is computed from unrounded figures and rounded once, so that it ties to the ledger even when the displayed lines do not add up to it.

operands.name: the unrounded figures of the lines
operands.source: the engines that produced them
operands.constraints: accumulated at full stored precision

operands.name: the displayed figures of the lines
operands.source: the same figures after rounding
operands.constraints: what the reader sees

operands.name: the rounding in force
operands.unit_or_currency: the report's whole-unit rounding, or the decimal places of the presentation currency
operands.source: the report definition and the currency
operands.constraints: decides the size of the difference

preconditions.condition: Intermediate sums were never rounded.
preconditions.otherwise: The total would tie to the displayed lines but no longer to the ledger, which is the wrong trade.

procedure: Compute the total from the unrounded figures of the lines.
Round the total once, at display.
Round each line once, at display, independently of the total.
Accept that the rounded total may differ from the sum of the rounded lines, and do not correct it.
records.formula:
displayed_total = round( Σ of the unrounded line figures )
                ≠ Σ of the rounded line figures, in general

rounding.what: The total and each line, separately.
rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, or whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once per figure, at display; never on an intermediate sum.

result.name: displayed total
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the total line; it ties to the ledger, not to the arithmetic of the displayed lines.

edge_cases.case: A column of three lines at ten point four each with whole-unit rounding.
edge_cases.outcome: The lines display ten, ten and ten and the total displays thirty-one, which is correct.

edge_cases.case: A reader adds the displayed lines.
edge_cases.outcome: They obtain thirty, which does not equal the ledger; the total does.

edge_cases.case: A legislation requires the total to equal the sum of the declared boxes.
edge_cases.outcome: The definition aggregates rounded expressions instead, which is a different calculation.

worked_examples.description: Three lines at ten point four under whole-unit rounding
worked_examples.narrative: The total is computed from thirty-one point two and displays thirty-one, while the three displayed lines add to thirty.

records.name: A total computed over the rounded expressions
records.purpose: Makes a total equal the sum of the declared boxes, as some legislations require, by giving each box a second rounded expression and aggregating those instead of the raw figures.

operands.name: the raw figure of each box
operands.source: the box's own expression
operands.constraints: unrounded

operands.name: the rounded figure of each box
operands.unit_or_currency: whole units of the presentation currency
operands.source: a second expression of the box whose subformula rounds to zero decimals
operands.constraints: ninety shipped expressions carry the label for a rounded balance

operands.name: the total expression
operands.unit_or_currency: an aggregation over the rounded expressions
operands.source: the report definition
operands.constraints: references the rounded labels, not the raw ones

preconditions.condition: Each box carries a second expression whose subformula rounds it.
preconditions.otherwise: The total aggregates the raw figures and may differ from the sum of the declared boxes.

preconditions.condition: The total expression references the rounded labels.
preconditions.otherwise: The same divergence appears.

procedure: Give each box a second expression, conventionally labelled with the rounded-balance label, whose subformula rounds the box to zero decimals.
Write the total as an aggregation over those rounded expressions.
Evaluate the rounded expressions first, then the total, which is guaranteed by the dependency order of the pipeline.
Display the total, which now equals the sum of the boxes as displayed.
records.formula:
box_rounded   = round( box_raw , 0 decimals )
declared_total = Σ over the boxes of box_rounded
               = Σ of the displayed boxes, exactly

rounding.what: Each box, before the total is taken.
rounding.precision: Zero decimal places, that is whole units.
rounding.step: On each box, before the aggregation, which is the whole point of the pattern.

result.name: declared total
result.unit_or_currency: whole units of the presentation currency
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the total line of the declaration and written to the legal filing, where it equals the sum of the declared boxes.

edge_cases.case: The total is aggregated over the raw figures instead.
edge_cases.outcome: It may differ from the sum of the displayed boxes by a unit or more, which the legislation refuses.

edge_cases.case: A box is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: Its rounded expression carries the half away from zero rule, so minus ten point five becomes minus eleven.

edge_cases.case: Ninety shipped expressions carry the rounded-balance label.
edge_cases.outcome: They exist for exactly this reason.

worked_examples.description: Three boxes at ten point four aggregated over their rounded expressions
worked_examples.narrative: Each box is rounded to ten first and the total is taken over the rounded boxes, giving thirty, which is exactly what the reader adds.

records.name: The account-type lines of the balance sheet
records.purpose: Produces the leaf figures of the statement of financial position, one line per account type, each reading the accounts of that type over the whole history corrected per account.

operands.name: the accounts of the line's type
operands.source: the chart of accounts of the selected companies, selected by the account code prefix engine over the accounts of one type
operands.constraints: one type per line: cash, receivable, current assets, prepayments, fixed assets, non-current assets, current liabilities, payable, credit card, non-current liabilities, unaffected earnings, equity and off balance

operands.name: the Journal Items on those accounts
operands.source: the ledger, over the from-beginning window corrected per account
operands.constraints: restricted by the base restriction

operands.name: the negation instruction of the line
operands.source: the report definition
operands.constraints: set on the liability, payable, credit card, non-current liability, unaffected earnings and equity lines

preconditions.condition: The report is opened with a single as-of date, the date range filter being off.
preconditions.otherwise: The from-date is ignored and the to-date carries the whole window.

preconditions.condition: Every Journal Entry balances.
preconditions.otherwise: The balancing identity of the statement does not hold.

procedure: Select the accounts of the line's type among the selected companies.
Read the Journal Items on those accounts over the from-beginning window, which for a balance-sheet account carries no lower bound and therefore accumulates all history.
Sum the signed balances of those items.
Negate the sum on the liability and equity lines, so that an amount owed and capital held read positive.
Roll the leaf lines up through the sums over children of the heading lines.
records.formula:
line_value = Σ over the items of the accounts of that type of ( debit − credit )
line_value = −1 × that sum    on the liability, payable, credit card, non-current liability, unaffected earnings and equity lines

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once per line, at display; the heading lines are computed from the unrounded children.

result.name: balance of the line
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the balance column of each period group; every account-type line unfolds into one row per account and each account row into its Journal Items.

edge_cases.case: An account that carries forward.
edge_cases.outcome: Its window has no lower bound, so the line accumulates every entry ever posted.

edge_cases.case: The current-year earnings account.
edge_cases.outcome: It does not carry forward, so its line covers the current fiscal year only.

edge_cases.case: The hierarchy filter is on.
edge_cases.outcome: The account rows are nested inside their account groups instead of being listed flat.

edge_cases.case: The horizontal split is on.
edge_cases.outcome: The asset subtree carries the left side and the liability and equity subtrees carry the right side, so the two halves print facing each other.

edge_cases.case: An aggregation line is reached.
edge_cases.outcome: It is not unfoldable, but its figure offers the audit action, which lists the union of the underlying items.

worked_examples.description: The current assets section of a statement
worked_examples.narrative: Eighteen thousand four hundred plus fifty-two thousand three hundred plus zero plus one thousand two hundred and fifty is seventy-one thousand nine hundred and fifty.

worked_examples.description: A payables line whose accounts total a credit
worked_examples.narrative: The accounts total a credit of thirty-eight thousand four hundred and the line negates it, so the amount owed reads positive.

records.name: The current year earnings line of the balance sheet
records.purpose: Places the result of the current fiscal year inside equity, so that the statement of financial position balances at every date without an accounting entry closing the year.

operands.name: the income figure of the period
operands.source: the income and other income account types
operands.constraints: carried as a credit, therefore negative before negation

operands.name: the expense figures of the period
operands.source: the expense, cost of revenue, depreciation and other expense account types
operands.constraints: carried as debits, therefore positive

operands.name: the current year allocated earnings
operands.source: the unaffected earnings accounts read over the from-fiscal-year window and negated
operands.constraints: a separate line of the same section

operands.name: the previous years unallocated earnings
operands.source: the unaffected earnings accounts read over the to-beginning-of-fiscal-year window and negated
operands.constraints: a separate line of the same section

preconditions.condition: The current-year earnings account does not carry forward.
preconditions.otherwise: The line would accumulate previous years as well and the statement would double-count the result.

preconditions.condition: The same accounts are read by the profit and loss statement.
preconditions.otherwise: The two statements would not agree.

procedure: Read the income, other income, expense, cost of revenue, depreciation and other expense account types over the same window.
Add their signed balances, which gives a negative figure for a profit.
Multiply by minus one, so that a profit reads positive.
Place the result under the unallocated earnings of the current year, beside the current year allocated earnings, and beside the previous years unallocated earnings read over the earlier window.
records.formula:
current_year_earnings = −1 × ( income + other income + expenses + cost of revenue
                              + depreciation + other expenses )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the account sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: current year earnings
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed inside the equity section; it equals the net result of the profit and loss statement from the first day of the fiscal year to the same date.

edge_cases.case: The net result of the profit and loss statement from the first day of the fiscal year to the report date.
edge_cases.outcome: It equals this line exactly, which a rebuild must be able to demonstrate; it does so automatically when both read the same accounts with the carry-forward correction.

edge_cases.case: The period is a loss.
edge_cases.outcome: The line is negative, which reduces equity.

edge_cases.case: The allocated earnings of the current year.
edge_cases.outcome: They are read from the unaffected earnings accounts over the fiscal year, negated, and shown on their own line.

edge_cases.case: The unallocated earnings of the previous years.
edge_cases.outcome: They are read from the same accounts over the window that ends the day before the fiscal year started, negated.

worked_examples.description: A fiscal year to date with income of eighty-five thousand credit and expenses of seventy-two thousand seven hundred debit
worked_examples.narrative: Minus eighty-five thousand plus seventy-two thousand seven hundred is minus twelve thousand three hundred, and the negation makes the profit read as twelve thousand three hundred.

records.name: The balancing identity of the balance sheet
records.purpose: States and proves the invariant that makes the statement of financial position a control document: total assets equal total liabilities plus total equity at every date.

operands.name: the total of the asset lines
operands.source: the asset subtree of the report
operands.constraints: raw signed balances

operands.name: the total of the liability lines
operands.source: the liability subtree, negated by the definition
operands.constraints: positive when amounts are owed

operands.name: the total of the equity lines
operands.source: the equity subtree, negated by the definition, including the current year earnings line
operands.constraints: positive when capital is held

operands.name: the sum of the signed balances of every account
operands.source: the ledger
operands.constraints: exactly zero, because every Journal Entry balances

preconditions.condition: Every Journal Entry balances, which the ledger enforces.
preconditions.otherwise: The identity fails and the statement does not balance.

preconditions.condition: The current year earnings line is present in the equity subtree.
preconditions.otherwise: The result of the year is missing from equity and the identity fails by exactly that result.

procedure: Observe that the sum of the signed balances of all accounts is zero, because every entry balances.
Split that sum by internal group into assets, liabilities, equity, income, expenses and off balance.
Note that the statement displays assets and off balance raw, and liabilities and equity negated.
Note that the statement adds the negated income-plus-expense sum inside equity as the current year earnings line.
Conclude that total assets equal the negated liabilities plus the negated equity plus the negated income and expenses, which is exactly the total of the liability and equity subtrees.
records.formula:
( assets ) + ( liabilities ) + ( equity ) + ( income ) + ( expenses ) + ( off balance ) = 0
ASSETS = −( liabilities ) − ( equity ) − ( income ) − ( expenses ) = LIABILITIES + EQUITY
ASSETS.balance = LIABILITIES.balance + EQUITY.balance

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once per total, at display; with whole-unit rounding the two sides may each differ from the sum of their own rounded lines while still equalling each other.

result.name: the balancing identity
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed as the equality of the assets line and the liabilities-plus-equity line of the statement.

edge_cases.case: The off-balance accounts carry a non-zero total.
edge_cases.outcome: They are displayed raw on their own top-level line and are included in the group sum that is zero, so the identity still holds.

edge_cases.case: The currency translation mode keeps the recorded rates.
edge_cases.outcome: The residual difference is presented on the cumulative translation adjustment line, which is what keeps the statement in balance without touching the ledger.

edge_cases.case: A draft entry is included by the option.
edge_cases.outcome: It balances like any other entry, so the identity is unaffected.

edge_cases.case: The report is rendered for a set of companies.
edge_cases.outcome: The identity holds over the set, because every entry of every company balances.

worked_examples.description: A statement at a date where the groups total zero
worked_examples.narrative: The six group sums add to zero; the statement shows assets of four hundred and twelve thousand three hundred, liabilities of two hundred and ten thousand and equity of one hundred and ninety thousand plus the current year earnings of twelve thousand three hundred, that is two hundred and two thousand three hundred, and the two sides are equal.

records.name: The liabilities plus equity line of the balance sheet
records.purpose: Prints the right-hand side of the statement as a single figure, so that a reader can compare it with the assets line at a glance.

operands.name: the liabilities total
operands.source: the sum over the children of the liabilities heading
operands.constraints: already negated by the leaf lines

operands.name: the equity total
operands.source: the sum over the children of the equity heading
operands.constraints: already negated by the leaf lines and including the current year earnings

preconditions.condition: Both headings produced a figure.
preconditions.otherwise: A heading that produced none contributes zero to the aggregation.

procedure: Read the balance of the liabilities heading.
Read the balance of the equity heading.
Add the two.
records.formula: LEQ.balance = LIABILITIES.balance + EQUITY.balance

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display, from the unrounded headings.

result.name: liabilities plus equity
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the last top-level line of the statement; it equals the assets line.

edge_cases.case: The statement does not balance.
edge_cases.outcome: Some Journal Entry does not balance, or the current year earnings line is missing; both are defects and not rounding.

edge_cases.case: Whole-unit rounding is on.
edge_cases.outcome: The line is computed from the unrounded headings and rounded once, so it may differ from the sum of the rounded headings.

edge_cases.case: The off-balance section carries a figure.
edge_cases.outcome: It is a separate top-level line and is not part of this sum.

worked_examples.description: The right-hand side of the worked statement
worked_examples.narrative: Two hundred and ten thousand plus two hundred and two thousand three hundred is four hundred and twelve thousand three hundred, which equals the assets line.

records.name: The account-type lines of the profit and loss statement
records.purpose: Produces the leaf figures of the statement of performance, one line per account type, over the movement of the requested period and nothing else.

operands.name: the accounts of the line's type
operands.source: the chart of accounts of the selected companies
operands.constraints: income, other income, cost of revenue, expenses, depreciation and other expenses

operands.name: the Journal Items on those accounts
operands.source: the ledger, over the strict range window
operands.constraints: restricted by the base restriction

operands.name: the negation instruction of the line
operands.source: the report definition
operands.constraints: set on the two income lines only

preconditions.condition: The report is opened over a date range.
preconditions.otherwise: A single date gives a window of one day, which is a period of one day and not an accumulated balance.

preconditions.condition: The window is the strict range.
preconditions.otherwise: The statement would show more than the requested period.

procedure: Select the accounts of the line's type among the selected companies.
Read the Journal Items on those accounts over the strict range window, so that only the movement of the requested period is counted.
Sum the signed balances.
Negate the sum on the operating income and other income lines, so that revenue earned reads positive; leave the four expense lines raw, because a cost incurred is already positive.
Set the growth flag on every expense line so that a decrease reads as favourable, and leave it at its default on every income line so that an increase reads as favourable.
records.formula:
line_value = Σ over the items of the accounts of that type of ( debit − credit )
line_value = −1 × that sum    on the operating income and other income lines

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.

result.name: balance of the line
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the balance column of each period group; account lines unfold into their Journal Items.

edge_cases.case: The report is rendered from the first day of the fiscal year to a date.
edge_cases.outcome: Its net result equals the current year earnings line of the statement of financial position at that date.

edge_cases.case: The hierarchy filter is on.
edge_cases.outcome: The account rows are nested inside their account groups.

edge_cases.case: Budgets are enabled on the report.
edge_cases.outcome: They are an optional filter of this statement and do not change the account-type figures.

edge_cases.case: An income line is negative after negation.
edge_cases.outcome: The period produced a net credit note position on that type, which is shown as a negative revenue.

worked_examples.description: The income and cost lines of a quarter
worked_examples.narrative: The income accounts total a credit of one hundred and twenty-eight thousand four hundred, which the negation turns positive; the cost accounts total a debit of sixty-one thousand two hundred, which is already positive.

records.name: The gross profit of the profit and loss statement
records.purpose: Gives the margin left after the direct cost of what was sold, which is the first subtotal a reader of the statement of performance looks for.

operands.name: the income total
operands.source: the sum over the children of the income heading, that is operating income plus other income
operands.constraints: already negated so that revenue reads positive

operands.name: the cost of revenue
operands.source: the accounts of the direct cost type, read raw
operands.constraints: positive when costs were incurred

preconditions.condition: Both lines produced a figure.
preconditions.otherwise: A line that produced none contributes zero.

procedure: Read the income heading's balance.
Read the cost of revenue line's balance.
Subtract the cost of revenue from the income.
records.formula: GROSS.balance = INC.balance − COST.balance

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display, from the unrounded operands.

result.name: gross profit
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed as a subtotal line of the statement, and read by the net profit line.

edge_cases.case: The cost of revenue exceeds the income.
edge_cases.outcome: The gross profit is negative, which is shown as a negative figure.

edge_cases.case: The period has no movement.
edge_cases.outcome: Both operands are zero and the subtotal is zero, not empty.

edge_cases.case: Growth is enabled.
edge_cases.outcome: The gross profit line compares like any other line, with a positive change read as favourable.

worked_examples.description: A quarter with income of one hundred and twenty-eight thousand four hundred and a cost of revenue of sixty-one thousand two hundred
worked_examples.narrative: One hundred and twenty-eight thousand four hundred less sixty-one thousand two hundred is sixty-seven thousand two hundred.

records.name: The net profit of the profit and loss statement
records.purpose: Gives the result of the period, which is the figure the statement of financial position carries inside equity as the earnings of the current year.

operands.name: the gross profit
operands.source: the gross profit subtotal
operands.constraints: income less cost of revenue

operands.name: the operating expenses
operands.source: the accounts of the expense type, read raw
operands.constraints: positive when costs were incurred

operands.name: the other income
operands.source: the accounts of the other income type, negated
operands.constraints: positive when revenue was earned

operands.name: the other expenses
operands.source: the accounts of the other expense type, read raw
operands.constraints: positive when costs were incurred

operands.name: the depreciation
operands.source: the accounts of the depreciation type, read raw
operands.constraints: positive when depreciation was charged

preconditions.condition: Every operand line produced a figure.
preconditions.otherwise: A line that produced none contributes zero.

preconditions.condition: The period runs from the first day of the fiscal year.
preconditions.otherwise: The net profit equals the current year earnings line of the statement of financial position only over that window.

procedure: Read the gross profit, the operating expenses, the other income, the other expenses and the depreciation.
Subtract the operating expenses from the gross profit.
Add the other income.
Subtract the other expenses.
Subtract the depreciation.
records.formula: NET.balance = GROSS.balance − OPEX.balance + OTHINC.balance − OTHEXP.balance − DEPR.balance

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display, from the unrounded operands.

result.name: net profit
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed as the top line of the statement; from the first day of the fiscal year to a date it equals the current year earnings line of the statement of financial position at that date.

edge_cases.case: The other income line appears twice in the arithmetic.
edge_cases.outcome: It is a child of the income heading, so it is already inside the gross profit, and the formula adds it again; this is recorded as observed and marked a compatibility finding, and a corrected behaviour would either drop the second term or keep other income out of the income heading. A rebuild that must tie to the shipped figures reproduces the formula exactly as stated.

edge_cases.case: The result is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The period is a loss, and the statement of financial position carries the loss inside equity.

edge_cases.case: Growth is enabled.
edge_cases.outcome: A shrinking loss reads as a positive growth, because the growth denominator is an absolute value.

worked_examples.description: A quarter with a gross profit of sixty-seven thousand two hundred
worked_examples.narrative: Sixty-seven thousand two hundred less fifty-two thousand four hundred, plus zero, less one thousand two hundred, less one thousand three hundred, is twelve thousand three hundred.

records.name: The gross profit margin of the summary statement
records.purpose: Expresses the margin left after the direct cost of sales as a share of revenue, which is the first performance ratio of the summary statement.

operands.name: income of the period
operands.source: the income lines of the statement of performance
operands.constraints: positive when revenue was earned

operands.name: cost of revenue of the period
operands.source: the direct cost line of the statement of performance
operands.constraints: positive when costs were incurred

preconditions.condition: The ratio line carries the clause that turns a division by zero into zero.
preconditions.otherwise: A period with a zero denominator renders an empty cell instead of a zero; every ratio line of this statement carries the clause, so the figure is zero.

procedure: Subtract the cost of revenue from the income.
Divide by the income.
Multiply by one hundred.
Render as a percentage; a zero income yields zero, because the line carries the clause that turns a division by zero into zero.
records.formula: gross_profit_margin = ( income − cost of revenue ) ÷ income × 100

rounding.precision: One decimal place, which is the precision the percentage display type renders; the document fixes it for that display type and this is the industry-standard default for the others.
rounding.step: Once, at display, after the whole arithmetic; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: gross profit margin
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the performance section of the summary statement, with the percentage display type; not auditable, because it is a derived ratio.

edge_cases.case: The income of the period is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The clause that turns a division by zero into zero gives zero rather than an empty cell.

edge_cases.case: The cost of revenue exceeds the income.
edge_cases.outcome: The ratio is negative, which reads as a negative margin.

edge_cases.case: The period is compared with an earlier one.
edge_cases.outcome: The ratio is computed independently in each column, never by ratio of ratios.

worked_examples.description: A quarter with income of one hundred and twenty-eight thousand four hundred and a cost of revenue of sixty-one thousand two hundred
worked_examples.narrative: Sixty-seven thousand two hundred divided by one hundred and twenty-eight thousand four hundred is nought point five two three three six and so on; times one hundred that is fifty-two point three three six, which rounds to fifty-two point three percent.

records.name: The net profit margin of the summary statement
records.purpose: Expresses the result of the period as a share of revenue, which says how much of every unit of revenue was kept.

operands.name: net profit of the period
operands.source: the net result of the statement of performance
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: income of the period
operands.source: the income lines of the statement of performance
operands.constraints: positive when revenue was earned

preconditions.condition: The ratio line carries the clause that turns a division by zero into zero.
preconditions.otherwise: A period with a zero denominator renders an empty cell instead of a zero; every ratio line of this statement carries the clause, so the figure is zero.

procedure: Take the net profit of the period.
Divide by the income.
Multiply by one hundred.
Render as a percentage; a zero income yields zero.
records.formula: net_profit_margin = net profit ÷ income × 100

rounding.precision: One decimal place, which is the precision the percentage display type renders; the document fixes it for that display type and this is the industry-standard default for the others.
rounding.step: Once, at display, after the whole arithmetic; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: net profit margin
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the performance section of the summary statement, with the percentage display type.

edge_cases.case: The income is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The clause gives zero rather than an empty cell.

edge_cases.case: The period is a loss.
edge_cases.outcome: The ratio is negative.

edge_cases.case: The net profit exceeds the income.
edge_cases.outcome: The ratio is above one hundred percent, which happens when other income is large.

worked_examples.description: A quarter with a net profit of twelve thousand three hundred and income of one hundred and twenty-eight thousand four hundred
worked_examples.narrative: Twelve thousand three hundred divided by one hundred and twenty-eight thousand four hundred is nought point zero nine five seven nine and so on; times one hundred that is nine point five seven nine, which rounds to nine point six percent.

records.name: The return on investment per annum of the summary statement
records.purpose: Annualises the result of the period against the net assets employed, so that a quarter and a year can be compared on the same scale.

operands.name: net profit of the period
operands.source: the net result of the statement of performance
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: assets
operands.source: the asset total of the statement of financial position
operands.constraints: at the report date

operands.name: liabilities
operands.source: the liability total of the statement of financial position
operands.constraints: at the report date

operands.name: days in period
operands.source: the from-date and the to-date of the rendering
operands.constraints: at least one

preconditions.condition: The ratio line carries the clause that turns a division by zero into zero.
preconditions.otherwise: A period with a zero denominator renders an empty cell instead of a zero; every ratio line of this statement carries the clause, so the figure is zero.

procedure: Subtract the liabilities from the assets to obtain the net assets employed.
Divide the net profit by that figure.
Multiply by one hundred.
Multiply by three hundred and sixty-five divided by the number of days in the period, which annualises the ratio.
Render as a percentage; zero net assets yield zero.
records.formula: return_on_investment = net profit ÷ ( assets − liabilities ) × 100 × ( 365 ÷ days in period )

rounding.precision: One decimal place, which is the precision the percentage display type renders; the document fixes it for that display type and this is the industry-standard default for the others.
rounding.step: Once, at display, after the whole arithmetic; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: return on investment per annum
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the performance section of the summary statement, with the percentage display type.

edge_cases.case: The assets equal the liabilities.
edge_cases.outcome: The denominator is zero and the clause gives zero rather than an empty cell.

edge_cases.case: The period is exactly one year of three hundred and sixty-five days.
edge_cases.outcome: The annualisation factor is one.

edge_cases.case: The period covers a leap year of three hundred and sixty-six days.
edge_cases.outcome: The factor is slightly below one, because the annualisation is fixed at three hundred and sixty-five days.

edge_cases.case: The net assets are negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The ratio is negative for a profit, which is arithmetically correct and economically a warning.

worked_examples.description: A quarter of ninety-one days with a net profit of twelve thousand three hundred and net assets of two hundred and two thousand three hundred
worked_examples.narrative: Twelve thousand three hundred divided by two hundred and two thousand three hundred is nought point zero six zero eight; times one hundred that is six point zero eight; times three hundred and sixty-five divided by ninety-one, that is four point zero one zero nine, gives twenty-four point three eight seven, which rounds to twenty-four point four percent.

records.name: The average debtors days of the summary statement
records.purpose: Says how many days of credit sales are tied up in receivables, which is the collection speed of the company.

operands.name: average receivable balance
operands.source: the receivable accounts over the period
operands.constraints: the average of the balance across the period

operands.name: credit sales of the period
operands.source: the sales accounts over the period
operands.constraints: positive when sales were made

operands.name: days in period
operands.source: the from-date and the to-date of the rendering
operands.constraints: at least one

preconditions.condition: The ratio line carries the clause that turns a division by zero into zero.
preconditions.otherwise: A period with a zero denominator renders an empty cell instead of a zero; every ratio line of this statement carries the clause, so the figure is zero.

procedure: Take the average receivable balance over the period.
Divide by the credit sales of the period.
Multiply by the number of days in the period.
Render as a plain number of days; zero credit sales yield zero.
records.formula: average_debtors_days = average receivable balance ÷ credit sales of the period × days in period

rounding.precision: One decimal place, which is the industry-standard default where the document does not fix the precision of the float display type.
rounding.step: Once, at display, after the whole arithmetic; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: average debtors days
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the position section of the summary statement, with the float display type.

edge_cases.case: The period has no credit sales.
edge_cases.outcome: The clause gives zero rather than an empty cell.

edge_cases.case: The receivable balance is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The ratio is zero days.

edge_cases.case: The period is short.
edge_cases.outcome: The ratio scales with the number of days in the period, so a one-month reading is not comparable with a one-quarter reading without care.

worked_examples.description: A quarter of ninety-one days with an average receivable balance of fifty-two thousand three hundred and credit sales of one hundred and twenty-eight thousand four hundred
worked_examples.narrative: Fifty-two thousand three hundred divided by one hundred and twenty-eight thousand four hundred is nought point four zero seven three two; times ninety-one that is thirty-seven point zero six six, which rounds to thirty-seven point one days.

records.name: The average creditors days of the summary statement
records.purpose: Says how many days of credit purchases are held in payables, which is the payment speed of the company.

operands.name: average payable balance
operands.source: the payable accounts over the period
operands.constraints: the average of the balance across the period

operands.name: credit purchases of the period
operands.source: the purchase accounts over the period
operands.constraints: positive when purchases were made

operands.name: days in period
operands.source: the from-date and the to-date of the rendering
operands.constraints: at least one

preconditions.condition: The ratio line carries the clause that turns a division by zero into zero.
preconditions.otherwise: A period with a zero denominator renders an empty cell instead of a zero; every ratio line of this statement carries the clause, so the figure is zero.

procedure: Take the average payable balance over the period.
Divide by the credit purchases of the period.
Multiply by the number of days in the period.
Render as a plain number of days; zero credit purchases yield zero.
records.formula: average_creditors_days = average payable balance ÷ credit purchases of the period × days in period

rounding.precision: One decimal place, which is the industry-standard default where the document does not fix the precision of the float display type.
rounding.step: Once, at display, after the whole arithmetic; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: average creditors days
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the position section of the summary statement, with the float display type.

edge_cases.case: The period has no credit purchases.
edge_cases.outcome: The clause gives zero rather than an empty cell.

edge_cases.case: The payable balance is zero.
edge_cases.outcome: The ratio is zero days.

edge_cases.case: The figure exceeds the supplier terms.
edge_cases.outcome: The company is paying late, which is what the ratio exists to reveal.

worked_examples.description: A quarter of ninety-one days with an average payable balance of thirty-one thousand eight hundred and credit purchases of sixty-one thousand two hundred
worked_examples.narrative: Thirty-one thousand eight hundred divided by sixty-one thousand two hundred is nought point five one nine six; times ninety-one that is forty-seven point two eight four, which rounds to forty-seven point three days.

records.name: The short-term cash forecast of the summary statement
records.purpose: Estimates the cash movement of the coming month from what is already on the sales and purchase accounts, which is the only forward-looking figure of the statement.

operands.name: balance of the sales accounts for the coming month
operands.source: the sales accounts, over the coming month
operands.constraints: positive when cash is expected in

operands.name: balance of the purchase accounts for the coming month
operands.source: the purchase accounts, over the coming month
operands.constraints: positive when cash is expected out

preconditions.condition: The ratio line carries the clause that turns a division by zero into zero.
preconditions.otherwise: A period with a zero denominator renders an empty cell instead of a zero; every ratio line of this statement carries the clause, so the figure is zero.

procedure: Read the balance of the sales accounts for the coming month.
Read the balance of the purchase accounts for the coming month.
Subtract the second from the first.
records.formula:
short_term_cash_forecast = balance of the sales accounts for the coming month
                         − balance of the purchase accounts for the coming month

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: short-term cash forecast
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the position section of the summary statement, with the monetary display type; it drills into its accounts.

edge_cases.case: The coming month has no expected movement.
edge_cases.outcome: The forecast is zero, not empty.

edge_cases.case: The purchases exceed the sales.
edge_cases.outcome: The forecast is negative, which warns of a cash shortfall.

edge_cases.case: The report is rendered for a past period.
edge_cases.outcome: The coming month is the month that follows the report's to-date, not the month that follows today.

worked_examples.description: A forecast over a coming month with expected receipts and payments
worked_examples.narrative: Forty-two thousand less twenty-seven thousand five hundred is fourteen thousand five hundred.

records.name: The ratio of current assets to current liabilities
records.purpose: Measures short-term solvency by comparing what will turn into cash within the year with what must be paid within the year.

operands.name: current assets
operands.source: the current assets subtree of the statement of financial position
operands.constraints: at the report date

operands.name: current liabilities
operands.source: the current liabilities subtree of the statement of financial position
operands.constraints: at the report date, already negated so that it is positive

preconditions.condition: The ratio line carries the clause that turns a division by zero into zero.
preconditions.otherwise: A period with a zero denominator renders an empty cell instead of a zero; every ratio line of this statement carries the clause, so the figure is zero.

procedure: Read the current assets at the report date.
Read the current liabilities at the report date.
Divide the first by the second.
Render as a plain number; zero current liabilities yield zero.
records.formula: current_assets_to_liabilities = current assets ÷ current liabilities

rounding.precision: One decimal place, which is the industry-standard default where the document does not fix the precision of the float display type.
rounding.step: Once, at display, after the whole arithmetic; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: ratio of current assets to current liabilities
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the position section of the summary statement, with the float display type.

edge_cases.case: There are no current liabilities.
edge_cases.outcome: The clause gives zero rather than an empty cell, which reads oddly for a company with no short-term debt and is the documented behaviour.

edge_cases.case: The ratio is below one.
edge_cases.outcome: The company cannot cover its short-term obligations from its current assets.

edge_cases.case: The current liabilities are negative after negation.
edge_cases.outcome: The ratio is negative, which indicates a debit balance on liability accounts and is a data problem rather than a solvency reading.

worked_examples.description: A statement with current assets of seventy-one thousand nine hundred and fifty and current liabilities of thirty-eight thousand four hundred
worked_examples.narrative: Seventy-one thousand nine hundred and fifty divided by thirty-eight thousand four hundred is one point eight seven three six, which rounds to one point nine.

records.name: The cash received of the summary statement
records.purpose: Totals the money that came into the cash and bank accounts during the period, which is the first of the three cash lines of the summary statement.

operands.name: the debits on the cash and bank accounts
operands.source: the Journal Items on the accounts of the cash type and the credit card type, over the period
operands.constraints: only the debit column is read

preconditions.condition: The report period is set.
preconditions.otherwise: There is no window and the figure is zero.

procedure: Take the Journal Items on the cash and bank accounts over the period.
Add their debit amounts, ignoring their credit amounts.
Display the total.
records.formula: cash_received = Σ over the items on the cash and bank accounts in the period of debit

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: cash received
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cash section of the summary statement, with the monetary display type; it drills into its accounts.

edge_cases.case: The period has no cash movement.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is zero, not empty.

edge_cases.case: An item carries both a debit and a credit.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the debit enters this line; the credit enters the cash spent line.

edge_cases.case: A transfer between two bank accounts.
edge_cases.outcome: It contributes a debit on one account and a credit on the other, so it inflates both lines and nets out in the cash surplus.

worked_examples.description: A quarter of bank activity
worked_examples.narrative: The debits total ninety-six thousand two hundred and fifty, which is what the line shows.

records.name: The cash spent of the summary statement
records.purpose: Totals the money that left the cash and bank accounts during the period, which is the second of the three cash lines of the summary statement.

operands.name: the credits on the cash and bank accounts
operands.source: the Journal Items on the accounts of the cash type and the credit card type, over the period
operands.constraints: only the credit column is read

preconditions.condition: The report period is set.
preconditions.otherwise: There is no window and the figure is zero.

procedure: Take the Journal Items on the cash and bank accounts over the period.
Add their credit amounts, ignoring their debit amounts.
Display the total.
records.formula: cash_spent = Σ over the items on the cash and bank accounts in the period of credit

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: cash spent
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cash section of the summary statement, with the monetary display type; it drills into its accounts.

edge_cases.case: The period has no cash movement.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is zero, not empty.

edge_cases.case: A transfer between two bank accounts.
edge_cases.outcome: It inflates this line and the cash received line equally and nets out in the cash surplus.

edge_cases.case: A payment is reversed inside the period.
edge_cases.outcome: Both the payment and its reversal appear, one on each of the two cash lines.

worked_examples.description: The same quarter of bank activity
worked_examples.narrative: The credits total eighty-one thousand seven hundred, which is what the line shows.

records.name: The cash surplus of the summary statement
records.purpose: Gives the net cash movement of the period as the difference between what came in and what went out.

operands.name: cash received
operands.source: the cash received line
operands.constraints: the sum of the debits on the cash and bank accounts

operands.name: cash spent
operands.source: the cash spent line
operands.constraints: the sum of the credits on the cash and bank accounts

preconditions.condition: Both lines produced a figure.
preconditions.otherwise: A line that produced none contributes zero.

procedure: Read the cash received line.
Read the cash spent line.
Subtract the second from the first.
records.formula: cash_surplus = cash received − cash spent

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: cash surplus
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cash section of the summary statement, with the monetary display type.

edge_cases.case: More money left than came in.
edge_cases.outcome: The surplus is negative, which is a deficit.

edge_cases.case: A transfer between two bank accounts.
edge_cases.outcome: It nets out here, because it contributed equally to both operands.

edge_cases.case: The period has no movement.
edge_cases.outcome: The surplus is zero.

worked_examples.description: The same quarter of bank activity
worked_examples.narrative: Ninety-six thousand two hundred and fifty less eighty-one thousand seven hundred is fourteen thousand five hundred and fifty.

records.name: The closing bank balance of the summary statement
records.purpose: Gives the money actually held at the report date, read over the whole history rather than over the period.

operands.name: the Journal Items on the cash and bank accounts
operands.source: the ledger, over the from-beginning window
operands.constraints: restricted by the base restriction

operands.name: the carry-forward property of those accounts
operands.source: the accounts
operands.constraints: cash and credit card accounts carry forward, so the window has no lower bound

preconditions.condition: The cash and bank accounts carry forward.
preconditions.otherwise: The window would start at the first day of the fiscal year and the line would show a movement rather than a balance.

procedure: Select the accounts of the cash type and the credit card type.
Read the Journal Items on them over the from-beginning window, which carries no lower bound for these accounts.
Sum their signed balances.
Display the total.
records.formula:
closing_bank_balance = Σ over every item on the cash and bank accounts up to the report date
                          of ( debit − credit )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: closing bank balance
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the cash section of the summary statement, with the monetary display type; it drills into its accounts.

edge_cases.case: The accounts include a credit card account in credit.
edge_cases.outcome: It reduces the figure, because the two account types are read together.

edge_cases.case: The report is rendered for a past date.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is the balance at that date, because the window ends at the to-date.

edge_cases.case: The period has no movement but earlier periods did.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is the earlier balance, not zero, which is the difference with the three period lines of the same section.

worked_examples.description: A statement whose cash and bank accounts hold eighteen thousand four hundred at the report date
worked_examples.narrative: The accumulated signed balance of eighteen thousand four hundred is the money held, and it matches the bank and cash line of the statement of financial position at the same date.

records.name: The initial balance line of the general ledger
records.purpose: Shows what each account carried before the requested period started, so that the period's movement can be read against a starting position.

operands.name: the accumulated balance of the account before the from-date
operands.source: the ledger over the to-beginning-of-period window, corrected per account
operands.constraints: restricted by the base restriction

operands.name: the carry-forward property of the account
operands.source: the account
operands.constraints: decides the lower bound of the window

operands.name: the option that shows the initial balance of every carrying account
operands.source: the user options
operands.constraints: when on, a row is emitted even for a zero initial balance

preconditions.condition: The requested period has a from-date.
preconditions.otherwise: A single-date rendering gives a window that ends the day before that date.

procedure: Read the Journal Items of the account over the to-beginning-of-period window, whose upper bound is the day before the from-date.
Sum their signed balances.
Emit one row per account whose accumulated balance is not zero, and additionally one per account that carries forward when the option to show it is on.
Order the rows by account code.
records.formula:
account_initial_balance = Σ over the items of the account up to the day before date_from
                             of ( debit − credit )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: initial balance of the account
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed as the initial balance row of the account, and added into the balance column of the account row when that row is displayed.

edge_cases.case: The account does not carry forward.
edge_cases.outcome: The window starts at the first day of the fiscal year that contains the day before the from-date.

edge_cases.case: The accumulated balance is zero and the option is off.
edge_cases.outcome: No initial balance row is emitted for that account.

edge_cases.case: The period starts on the first day of the fiscal year.
edge_cases.outcome: The window ends on the last day of the previous fiscal year.

worked_examples.description: An asset account with a balance before the period
worked_examples.narrative: Nine thousand four hundred less one thousand two hundred is eight thousand two hundred, which the initial balance row shows.

records.name: The end balance of an account in the general ledger
records.purpose: Gives the balance an account reaches at the end of the requested period, which is the balance column of the account row.

operands.name: the initial balance of the account
operands.source: the to-beginning-of-period window
operands.constraints: zero when the account had none

operands.name: the debits of the period
operands.source: the Journal Items of the account over the strict range window
operands.constraints: summed as the debit column

operands.name: the credits of the period
operands.source: the same items
operands.constraints: summed as the credit column

preconditions.condition: The initial balance row is displayed.
preconditions.otherwise: The balance column shows the period movement alone, without the initial balance.

preconditions.condition: The account has at least one item in the window.
preconditions.otherwise: No account row is emitted at all.

procedure: Sum the debits of the account over the requested period, which is the debit column.
Sum the credits over the same window, which is the credit column.
Subtract the credits from the debits to obtain the period movement.
Add the initial balance when the initial balance row is displayed.
records.formula: account_end_balance = account_initial_balance + Σ over the items in the window of ( debit − credit )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: end balance of the account
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the balance column of the account row; a total row sums every account row.

edge_cases.case: The initial balance row is not displayed.
edge_cases.outcome: The balance column carries the period movement alone.

edge_cases.case: The account has no item in the window but a non-zero initial balance.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the initial balance row is emitted.

edge_cases.case: The account count exceeds the prefix-group threshold.
edge_cases.outcome: Prefix groups are inserted on the account code.

worked_examples.description: An account with an initial balance and a period movement
worked_examples.narrative: Three thousand one hundred and fifty less one thousand four hundred and fifty is one thousand seven hundred, and eight thousand two hundred plus one thousand seven hundred is nine thousand nine hundred.

records.name: The running balance of an item row of the general ledger
records.purpose: Gives each item row the balance the account stood at after that item, so that a reader can follow an account line by line.

operands.name: the initial balance of the account
operands.source: the to-beginning-of-period window
operands.constraints: the starting point of the running total

operands.name: the ordered items of the window
operands.source: the Journal Items of the account, ordered by accounting date, then by entry number, then by item identifier
operands.constraints: the order fixes the running total

operands.name: the position of the row
operands.source: the ordering
operands.constraints: the running balance of the row at position k covers the first k items

preconditions.condition: The ordering is the one the report uses.
preconditions.otherwise: The running balance is not reproducible, because a different order gives different intermediate figures.

procedure: Order the items of the account inside the window by accounting date, then by entry number, then by item identifier.
Start from the initial balance of the account.
For each row in order, add the item's debit and subtract its credit.
Display the running total on the row, together with the date, the entry number, the partner, the label, the matching number, the currency amount, the debit and the credit.
records.formula: running_balance( k ) = account_initial_balance + Σ over the first k items of ( debit − credit )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: running balance of the row
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the running balance column of the item row; the last row's running balance equals the account's end balance.

edge_cases.case: The account is collapsed and re-expanded.
edge_cases.outcome: The same rows appear in the same order, so the running balances are unchanged.

edge_cases.case: The expansion exceeds the load-more limit.
edge_cases.outcome: The running balance continues from the offset when the next batch is produced.

edge_cases.case: Two items share a date and an entry number.
edge_cases.outcome: The item identifier breaks the tie, which is what makes the order total.

edge_cases.case: An item row is opened.
edge_cases.outcome: It opens its Journal Entry.

worked_examples.description: Three item rows after an initial balance of eight thousand two hundred
worked_examples.narrative: Eight thousand two hundred plus three thousand one hundred and fifty is eleven thousand three hundred and fifty; less one thousand four hundred and fifty is nine thousand nine hundred; a zero-amount row leaves the running balance unchanged.

records.name: The initial columns of the trial balance
records.purpose: Splits each account's opening position into a debit column and a credit column by its sign, which is how a trial balance presents a netted figure.

operands.name: the signed balance of the account before the period
operands.source: the ledger over the to-beginning-of-period window
operands.constraints: restricted by the base restriction

preconditions.condition: The account has any movement in the window or a non-zero initial balance.
preconditions.otherwise: No row is emitted for that account.

procedure: Read the signed balance of the account at the day before the from-date.
When it is positive, place it in the initial debit column and place zero in the initial credit column.
When it is negative, place its negation in the initial credit column and place zero in the initial debit column.
When it is zero, place zero in both.
records.formula:
initial_debit  = initial   when initial > 0, else 0
initial_credit = −initial  when initial < 0, else 0

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: initial debit and initial credit of the account
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the two columns of the initial balance group of the statement.

edge_cases.case: The initial balance is exactly zero.
edge_cases.outcome: Both columns show zero.

edge_cases.case: The columns are netted, not gross.
edge_cases.outcome: This is the difference with the period columns, which show gross debits and credits.

edge_cases.case: The account did not exist before the period.
edge_cases.outcome: Its initial balance is zero and both columns show zero.

worked_examples.description: An account carrying a debit position before the period and another carrying a credit position
worked_examples.narrative: A positive opening of eight thousand two hundred goes to the debit column; a negative opening of minus three thousand one hundred and fifty is negated and goes to the credit column.

records.name: The period columns of the trial balance
records.purpose: Shows the gross debits and the gross credits of the period rather than their netted difference, which is what makes the trial balance a control document.

operands.name: the debits of the account in the window
operands.source: the Journal Items of the account over the strict range window
operands.constraints: summed as they stand

operands.name: the credits of the account in the window
operands.source: the same items
operands.constraints: summed as they stand

preconditions.condition: The window is the requested period.
preconditions.otherwise: The columns cover the wrong span.

preconditions.condition: The two columns are summed gross.
preconditions.otherwise: The control identity that the two period totals are equal no longer holds.

procedure: Take the Journal Items of the account inside the requested period.
Add their debit amounts into the period debit column, without subtracting anything.
Add their credit amounts into the period credit column, without subtracting anything.
Do not net the two columns against each other.
records.formula:
period_debit  = Σ over the items in the window of debit
period_credit = Σ over the items in the window of credit

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: period debit and period credit of the account
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the two columns of the period group; the two column totals must be equal.

edge_cases.case: An account has movements in both directions.
edge_cases.outcome: Both columns carry a figure, unlike the initial and end columns where only one can.

edge_cases.case: An item carries a zero debit and a zero credit.
edge_cases.outcome: It contributes nothing to either column.

edge_cases.case: The period columns are compared with the initial and end columns.
edge_cases.outcome: They are gross while the others are netted, and the asymmetry is intentional.

worked_examples.description: An account with movements in both directions
worked_examples.narrative: Both columns carry their own gross total, and the netted movement of one thousand seven hundred appears nowhere in this group.

records.name: The end columns of the trial balance
records.purpose: Splits each account's closing position into a debit column and a credit column by its sign, after adding the period movement to the opening position.

operands.name: the initial signed balance
operands.source: the to-beginning-of-period window
operands.constraints: may be positive, negative or zero

operands.name: the movement of the period
operands.source: the netted signed balance over the strict range window
operands.constraints: the difference between the gross period debits and the gross period credits

preconditions.condition: The two figures are computed over the same restriction.
preconditions.otherwise: The closing position does not tie to the ledger.

procedure: Add the movement of the period to the initial signed balance to obtain the closing position.
When the closing position is positive, place it in the end debit column and place zero in the end credit column.
When it is negative, place its negation in the end credit column and place zero in the end debit column.
When it is zero, place zero in both.
records.formula:
end        = initial + movement
end_debit  = end   when end > 0, else 0
end_credit = −end  when end < 0, else 0

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: end debit and end credit of the account
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the two columns of the end balance group of the statement.

edge_cases.case: The closing position is exactly zero.
edge_cases.outcome: Both columns show zero, which happens when an account has been cleared.

edge_cases.case: An account moved from a debit to a credit position.
edge_cases.outcome: Its initial figure sits in the debit column and its end figure in the credit column.

edge_cases.case: The account row is unfolded.
edge_cases.outcome: It expands into its Journal Items, exactly as in the general ledger.

worked_examples.description: An account opening in debit and moving further into debit
worked_examples.narrative: Three thousand one hundred and fifty less one thousand four hundred and fifty is one thousand seven hundred; eight thousand two hundred plus one thousand seven hundred is nine thousand nine hundred, which is positive and goes to the end debit column.

worked_examples.description: An account opening in debit and closing in credit
worked_examples.narrative: Five hundred less one thousand two hundred is minus seven hundred, which is negated into the end credit column.

records.name: The control identity of the trial balance
records.purpose: States the invariant that makes the statement a control: the total of the period debit column equals the total of the period credit column, for every period and every filter combination.

operands.name: the period debit column of every account row
operands.source: the gross period debits
operands.constraints: summed over the rows

operands.name: the period credit column of every account row
operands.source: the gross period credits
operands.constraints: summed over the rows

preconditions.condition: The base restriction keeps whole Journal Entries rather than parts of them.
preconditions.otherwise: The identity fails: a filter that keeps one side of an entry and drops the other breaks the equality, which is a legitimate consequence of a partner or an analytic filter and not a defect.

preconditions.condition: Every Journal Entry balances.
preconditions.otherwise: The identity fails, which the ledger prevents.

procedure: Sum the period debit column over every account row.
Sum the period credit column over every account row.
Compare the two totals, which must be equal.
records.formula: Σ over the accounts of period_debit = Σ over the accounts of period_credit

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once per total, at display; with whole-unit rounding each total is rounded from its own unrounded sum.

result.name: the two period totals
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the total row of the statement; their equality is the control the document exists for.

edge_cases.case: A partner filter keeps only one side of an entry.
edge_cases.outcome: The two totals differ, because the restriction no longer keeps whole entries; this is a property of the filter, not of the statement.

edge_cases.case: Draft entries are included.
edge_cases.outcome: They balance like any other entry and the identity holds.

edge_cases.case: The report is rendered for several companies.
