edge_cases.outcome: The identity holds over the set, because every entry of every company balances.

worked_examples.description: A period whose rows total the same on both sides
worked_examples.narrative: The two totals are equal to the cent, which is what the reader checks first.

records.name: The balance of a partner in the partner ledger
records.purpose: Gives each partner row its position, by adding the period movement of that partner's items to the position the partner held before the period.

operands.name: the initial balance of the partner
operands.source: the partner's items before the period
operands.constraints: zero when the partner had none

operands.name: the items of the partner in the window
operands.source: the Journal Items on a receivable or payable account, or on any account when the account-type filter is disabled
operands.constraints: restricted by the base restriction

operands.name: the debit and credit of each item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: not negative

preconditions.condition: The partner has at least one item in the window, or a non-zero initial balance.
preconditions.otherwise: No row is emitted for that partner.

preconditions.condition: The account-type filter is set.
preconditions.otherwise: It defaults to both receivable and payable accounts.

procedure: Read the partner's initial balance before the period.
Take the partner's Journal Items inside the window, on a receivable or payable account, or on any account when the account-type filter is disabled.
Add the debit and subtract the credit of each item.
Add the result to the initial balance.
Order the partner rows by partner display name, emit one row for the items with no partner, named for the absence, and close with a total row.
records.formula: partner_balance = initial_balance_of_the_partner + Σ over the items in the window of ( debit − credit )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: balance of the partner
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the balance column of the partner row; expanding a partner shows its items with the date, the entry number, the account, the reference, the due date, the matching number, the debit, the credit and a running balance.

edge_cases.case: Items carry no partner.
edge_cases.outcome: They are gathered on one row named for the absence of a partner.

edge_cases.case: The unreconciled option is on.
edge_cases.outcome: Only items on reconcilable accounts with a non-zero residual are read, so the row shows the open position.

edge_cases.case: A matching number is opened.
edge_cases.outcome: It opens the set of items reconciled together.

edge_cases.case: An item row is opened.
edge_cases.outcome: It opens its Journal Entry.

worked_examples.description: A customer with an opening position and two movements
worked_examples.narrative: Four thousand two hundred plus one thousand eight hundred and fifty less nine hundred and ninety is five thousand and sixty.

records.name: The days overdue of an open item
records.purpose: Measures how late an open item is at the report date, which is the single quantity that assigns it to an aging bucket.

operands.name: reference date
operands.source: the single as-of date of the report
operands.constraints: the report has no date range

operands.name: due date of the item
operands.source: the item's maturity date when it is set, and its accounting date otherwise
operands.constraints: always defined by that fallback

preconditions.condition: The item's accounting date is on or before the reference date.
preconditions.otherwise: The item is not shown at all, because it did not exist at the reference date.

preconditions.condition: The item's residual at the reference date is not zero.
preconditions.otherwise: The item is not shown, because it was already settled.

procedure: Take the item's maturity date when it is set, and its accounting date otherwise, as the due date.
Subtract the due date from the reference date, in whole days.
Use the result to choose the bucket.
records.formula: days_overdue = reference_date − due_date        in whole days

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded: the result is a whole number of days.
rounding.precision: Whole days.
rounding.step: No rounding step.

result.name: days overdue
result.stored_or_displayed: Not displayed as such; it chooses the aging bucket the item's amount is placed in.

edge_cases.case: The due date is after the reference date.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is negative and the item falls in the not-due bucket.

edge_cases.case: The due date is the reference date.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is zero and the item falls in the not-due bucket, because that bucket takes everything at or below zero.

edge_cases.case: The item carries no maturity date.
edge_cases.outcome: Its accounting date is used instead.

worked_examples.description: Five open items of one customer at a reference date of the thirtieth of June
worked_examples.narrative: The fifteenth of July is fifteen days after the reference date, giving minus fifteen; the other four are ten, forty-nine, ninety-one and two hundred and thirty-eight days late.

records.name: The aging bucket of an open item
records.purpose: Places an open item in one of six columns by how late it is, which is the whole structure of the aged statements.

operands.name: days overdue
operands.source: the difference between the reference date and the due date
operands.constraints: may be negative

operands.name: the bucket boundaries
operands.source: the report definition
operands.constraints: thirty-day buckets counted back from the reference date, with a single tail bucket beyond one hundred and twenty days, which is the industry-standard default

preconditions.condition: The item is shown at all.
preconditions.otherwise: It is not placed in any bucket.

procedure: Place the item in the not-due bucket when the days overdue are zero or less.
Place it in the first bucket when the days overdue are between one and thirty.
Place it in the second bucket when they are between thirty-one and sixty.
Place it in the third bucket when they are between sixty-one and ninety.
Place it in the fourth bucket when they are between ninety-one and one hundred and twenty.
Place it in the tail bucket when they are one hundred and twenty-one or more.
records.formula:
bucket = not due       when days_overdue ≤ 0
bucket = 1 to 30      when 1 ≤ days_overdue ≤ 30
bucket = 31 to 60     when 31 ≤ days_overdue ≤ 60
bucket = 61 to 90     when 61 ≤ days_overdue ≤ 90
bucket = 91 to 120    when 91 ≤ days_overdue ≤ 120
bucket = older        when days_overdue ≥ 121

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded: the assignment is by whole days.
rounding.precision: Whole days.
rounding.step: No rounding step; the boundaries are inclusive as written.

result.name: the bucket of the item
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed as the column the item's amount appears in, on the item row and in the partner row's totals.

edge_cases.case: An item is exactly ninety-one days late.
edge_cases.outcome: It falls in the fourth bucket and not in the third, because the third ends at ninety.

edge_cases.case: An item is due on the reference date.
edge_cases.outcome: It is not due, because the first bucket starts at one day.

edge_cases.case: An item is more than one hundred and twenty days late.
edge_cases.outcome: It falls in the single tail bucket, however late it is.

edge_cases.case: The boundaries themselves.
edge_cases.outcome: They are the industry-standard default: thirty-day buckets counted back from the reference date with one tail bucket.

worked_examples.description: The same five open items
worked_examples.narrative: The item ninety-one days late sits in the bucket from ninety-one to one hundred and twenty, which is the boundary a rebuild most often gets wrong.

records.name: The residual of an item at the reference date
records.purpose: Reconstructs how much of an item was still open at a past date, which is what makes an aged statement reproducible when it is rendered again later.

operands.name: the balance of the item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: the signed amount of the item

operands.name: the partial reconciliations involving the item
operands.source: the reconciliations of the item
operands.constraints: each carries its own date and signed amount

operands.name: reference date
operands.source: the single as-of date of the report
operands.constraints: reconciliations later than it are ignored

preconditions.condition: The item sits on a receivable account for the receivable statement, or on a payable account for the payable statement.
preconditions.otherwise: It is not shown.

preconditions.condition: The item's Journal Entry is posted, or draft while the option is on.
preconditions.otherwise: It is not shown.

preconditions.condition: The item's accounting date is on or before the reference date.
preconditions.otherwise: It is not shown.

procedure: Take the balance of the item.
Take the partial reconciliations that involve the item and whose own date is on or before the reference date.
Subtract their signed amounts from the balance.
Show the item only when the result is not zero.
records.formula:
residual_at( reference_date ) = item_balance
                              − Σ over the partial reconciliations p involving the item,
                                  with date(p) ≤ reference_date,
                                  of signed_amount(p)

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: residual of the item at the reference date
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed as the item's amount in its bucket, and summed into the partner row.

edge_cases.case: An item was fully reconciled after the reference date.
edge_cases.outcome: It is still shown as open, which is what makes the statement reproducible at a past date.

edge_cases.case: An item was fully reconciled before the reference date.
edge_cases.outcome: Its residual is zero and it is not shown.

edge_cases.case: An item was partly reconciled before the reference date.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the unsettled part is shown.

edge_cases.case: A draft entry is included by the option.
edge_cases.outcome: Its items are shown, although a draft document has not yet created a receivable in law.

worked_examples.description: An invoice of four thousand two hundred partly settled before the reference date and further settled after it
worked_examples.narrative: The later reconciliation is ignored because its date is after the reference date, so the whole four thousand two hundred is still shown as open.

worked_examples.description: The same invoice with one thousand two hundred settled before the reference date
worked_examples.narrative: Four thousand two hundred less one thousand two hundred is three thousand, which is the amount placed in the bucket.

records.name: The amount shown by the aged receivable statement
records.purpose: Presents the residual of a receivable item as it stands, so that a customer who owes money reads as a positive amount.

operands.name: the residual of the item at the reference date
operands.source: the residual calculation
operands.constraints: not zero, or the item is not shown

operands.name: the account of the item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: a receivable account

preconditions.condition: The item sits on a receivable account.
preconditions.otherwise: It belongs to the payable statement instead, or to neither.

procedure: Compute the residual of the item at the reference date.
Show it as it stands, with no negation.
Place it in the bucket the days overdue choose.
records.formula: displayed_amount = residual_at( reference_date )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: amount owed by the partner
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the bucket column of the item row and summed into the partner row and the total row.

edge_cases.case: A customer is in credit.
edge_cases.outcome: The residual is negative and the amount reads negative, which is a credit note or an overpayment awaiting allocation.

edge_cases.case: An item row is opened.
edge_cases.outcome: It opens the invoice, bill, payment or entry that produced it.

edge_cases.case: The statement is rendered again at the same reference date later.
edge_cases.outcome: It produces the same figures, because the residual is reconstructed at that date.

worked_examples.description: Five open receivable items of one customer at the thirtieth of June
worked_examples.narrative: Each residual is shown as it stands in its own bucket, so every figure of the row is positive for a customer who owes money.

records.name: The amount shown by the aged payable statement
records.purpose: Negates the residual of a payable item, so that a supplier the company owes reads as a positive amount on the same bucket structure.

operands.name: the residual of the item at the reference date
operands.source: the residual calculation
operands.constraints: negative for an ordinary payable, because a payable sits on the credit side

operands.name: the account of the item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: a payable account

preconditions.condition: The item sits on a payable account.
preconditions.otherwise: It belongs to the receivable statement instead, or to neither.

procedure: Compute the residual of the item at the reference date.
Multiply it by minus one.
Place the result in the bucket the days overdue choose.
records.formula: displayed_amount = −1 × residual_at( reference_date )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: amount owed to the partner
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the bucket column of the item row and summed into the partner row and the total row.

edge_cases.case: A supplier is in debit.
edge_cases.outcome: The residual is positive and the negated amount reads negative, which is a debit note or an advance paid.

edge_cases.case: The two statements are compared.
edge_cases.outcome: They use the same bucket structure and the same residual rule, and differ only by this negation.

edge_cases.case: An item row is opened.
edge_cases.outcome: It opens the bill, payment or entry that produced it.

worked_examples.description: A supplier invoice of three thousand four hundred still open at the reference date
worked_examples.narrative: The payable residual of minus three thousand four hundred is negated, so the amount the company owes reads as three thousand four hundred.

records.name: The partner total and the report total of an aged statement
records.purpose: Adds the buckets of a partner into the partner's position and the partner rows into the statement's total, which is the figure a reader reconciles with the ledger.

operands.name: the bucket figures of a partner
operands.source: the sums of that partner's item amounts in each bucket
operands.constraints: six buckets, any of which may be zero

operands.name: the partner totals
operands.source: the partner rows
operands.constraints: one per partner shown

preconditions.condition: Every open item was placed in exactly one bucket.
preconditions.otherwise: The partner total does not equal the sum of the partner's items.

procedure: Sum the amounts of a partner's items inside each bucket to obtain the six bucket figures.
Add the six bucket figures to obtain the partner total.
Add the partner totals to obtain the report total.
Order the item rows of each partner by due date.
records.formula:
partner_total = Σ over the buckets b of partner_bucket( b )
report_total  = Σ over the partners of partner_total

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: partner total and report total
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the total column of each partner row and on the total row of the statement.

edge_cases.case: A bucket has no item.
edge_cases.outcome: It shows zero and contributes zero.

edge_cases.case: A partner has one item only.
edge_cases.outcome: The partner total equals that item's amount.

edge_cases.case: The statement is rendered under whole-unit rounding.
edge_cases.outcome: The totals are computed unrounded and rounded once, so they may differ from the sum of the displayed buckets.

worked_examples.description: One customer with five open items at the thirtieth of June
worked_examples.narrative: Four thousand two hundred plus one thousand eight hundred and fifty plus nine hundred and ninety plus zero plus three thousand one hundred plus six hundred and twenty is ten thousand seven hundred and sixty.

records.name: The classification of a cash movement
records.purpose: Assigns every movement of the cash accounts to one of four sections by the tags on the counterpart accounts of the same entry, which is the direct method the statement uses.

operands.name: the items on the cash accounts
operands.source: the Journal Items on the accounts of the cash type and the credit card type
operands.constraints: every such item is a cash movement

operands.name: the counterpart items of the same entry
operands.source: the other items of the entry
operands.constraints: they classify the movement

operands.name: the tags on the counterpart accounts
operands.unit_or_currency: one of three shipped tags, or none
operands.source: the account tags
operands.constraints: the operating tag, the investing and extraordinary tag and the financing tag are shipped and cannot be deleted

preconditions.condition: The three shipped tags exist.
preconditions.otherwise: They may not be deleted; the chart of accounts templates apply them to the appropriate accounts.

preconditions.condition: Every cash movement has at least one counterpart item.
preconditions.otherwise: It cannot be classified and falls into the unclassified section, which is what guarantees the reconciliation identity.

procedure: Take every Journal Item on an account of the cash type or the credit card type inside the window.
Look at the counterpart items of the same entry.

Classify the movement into the operating section when a counterpart account carries the operating tag, into the investing and extraordinary section when it carries that tag, and into the financing section when it carries the financing tag.
Classify it into the unclassified section when no counterpart account carries any of the three tags.
Sum the cash side of the classified movements into the section's line.
records.formula:
section( cash movement ) = the section named by the tag of the counterpart account
section( cash movement ) = unclassified    when no counterpart account carries one of the three tags
line_value( section )    = Σ over the cash side of the movements of that section of ( debit − credit )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: the figure of each section
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the section lines of the statement; each section unfolds into one row per counterpart account, and each of those into the Journal Items of the cash side.

edge_cases.case: A counterpart account carries none of the three tags.
edge_cases.outcome: The movement falls into the unclassified section, which catches everything the tags miss.

edge_cases.case: The three tags are shipped and may not be deleted.
edge_cases.outcome: A deletion guard refuses it.

edge_cases.case: A movement has counterparts in two sections.
edge_cases.outcome: Each counterpart classifies its own share of the movement, so the sections still partition the counterparts.

edge_cases.case: A prepayment to or from a partner.
edge_cases.outcome: It is reported on its own sub-line of the operating section, separately from the ordinary receipts and payments.

worked_examples.description: A quarter of cash movements over four sections
worked_examples.narrative: Twenty-one thousand four hundred less nine thousand plus two thousand plus one hundred and fifty is fourteen thousand five hundred and fifty, which is the net increase line.

records.name: The opening and closing cash lines of the cash flow statement
records.purpose: Gives the two position lines that bracket the movement lines, one read before the period and one read up to its end.

operands.name: the cash accounts
operands.source: the accounts of the cash type and the credit card type
operands.constraints: the same set the movement lines read

operands.name: the window before the period
operands.unit_or_currency: a first day, open, and a last day
operands.source: the to-beginning-of-period date scope
operands.constraints: the opening line

operands.name: the window up to the report date
operands.unit_or_currency: a first day, open, and a last day
operands.source: the from-beginning date scope
operands.constraints: the closing line

preconditions.condition: The cash accounts carry forward.
preconditions.otherwise: The two lines would show movements rather than positions.

procedure: Read the Journal Items of the cash accounts over the window that ends the day before the period starts, and sum their signed balances: that is the opening line.
Read the Journal Items of the same accounts over the window that ends at the report date, and sum their signed balances: that is the closing line.
Place the movement sections between the two lines.
records.formula:
opening_cash = Σ over every item on the cash accounts up to the day before date_from of ( debit − credit )
closing_cash = Σ over every item on the cash accounts up to date_to           of ( debit − credit )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: opening cash and closing cash
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed as the first and the last line of the statement.

edge_cases.case: The company held no cash before the period.
edge_cases.outcome: The opening line is zero.

edge_cases.case: A credit card account is in credit.
edge_cases.outcome: It reduces both lines, because the two account types are read together.

edge_cases.case: The statement is rendered for a past period.
edge_cases.outcome: Both lines are reconstructed at their own dates, so the statement is reproducible.

worked_examples.description: A quarter bracketed by its two cash positions
worked_examples.narrative: Three thousand eight hundred and fifty plus fourteen thousand five hundred and fifty is eighteen thousand four hundred, which the closing line shows.

records.name: The reconciliation identity of the cash flow statement
records.purpose: States the invariant that makes the statement a control: the closing cash equals the opening cash plus the net increase, exactly.

operands.name: opening cash
operands.source: the cash accounts before the period
operands.constraints: read over the window that ends the day before the period

operands.name: net increase
operands.source: the sum over the children of the net increase heading
operands.constraints: the four sections

operands.name: closing cash
operands.source: the cash accounts up to the report date
operands.constraints: read over the window that ends at the report date

preconditions.condition: Every cash movement is counted exactly once.
preconditions.otherwise: The identity fails; it holds because the sections partition the counterparts and the unclassified section catches everything the three tags miss.

procedure: Compute the opening cash line.
Compute the four section lines and add them into the net increase line.
Compute the closing cash line.
Check that the closing cash equals the opening cash plus the net increase.
records.formula: closing_cash = opening_cash + net_increase

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once per line, at display; the identity holds on the unrounded figures and may show a rounding difference of one unit under whole-unit rounding.

result.name: the reconciliation identity
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed as the agreement of the opening line plus the net increase with the closing line.

edge_cases.case: A cash movement has an untagged counterpart.
edge_cases.outcome: It is counted in the unclassified section, so the identity still holds.

edge_cases.case: A movement between two cash accounts.
edge_cases.outcome: Both sides are cash, so the movement nets to zero inside the sections and the identity is unaffected.

edge_cases.case: The identity fails.
edge_cases.outcome: Some cash movement was counted twice or not at all, which is a defect a rebuild must find.

worked_examples.description: A quarter whose sections sum to the movement between the two positions
worked_examples.narrative: The four sections give fourteen thousand five hundred and fifty and three thousand eight hundred and fifty plus that figure is eighteen thousand four hundred, the closing position.

records.name: The net base of a tax in the journal audit summary
records.purpose: Totals the amounts a tax was applied to inside one journal and one period, which is the first column of the tax summary block of the journal audit.

operands.name: the items of the window whose tax set contains the tax
operands.source: the Journal Items of that journal inside the window
operands.constraints: restricted by the base restriction

operands.name: the debit and credit of each item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: not negative

preconditions.condition: The journal is a sale journal or a purchase journal.
preconditions.otherwise: No tax summary block is emitted at all; the tax columns exist only for those two journal types.

procedure: Take the Journal Items of the journal inside the window whose tax set contains the tax.
Add the debit and subtract the credit of each of them.
Emit one summary row per tax appearing in the journal in the window, after the entries.
records.formula: tax_summary_base( t ) = Σ over the items in the window whose tax set contains t of ( debit − credit )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: net base of the tax
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the tax summary block of the journal section; the row opens the items behind it.

edge_cases.case: No item bears the tax.
edge_cases.outcome: No summary row is emitted for that tax.

edge_cases.case: A sale journal.
edge_cases.outcome: The bases sit on the credit side, so the figure is negative before any presentation choice.

edge_cases.case: An item bears two taxes.
edge_cases.outcome: It contributes its whole balance to each of their bases, because a tax set is not a share.

worked_examples.description: A sale journal in a quarter with one tax applied to two documents
worked_examples.narrative: Zero less ten thousand plus one thousand five hundred less zero is minus eight thousand five hundred, the net base of the tax in that journal.

records.name: The tax amount of a tax in the journal audit summary
records.purpose: Totals the tax a tax produced inside one journal and one period, which is the second column of the tax summary block of the journal audit.

operands.name: the items of the window that are the tax line of the tax
operands.source: the Journal Items of that journal inside the window
operands.constraints: restricted by the base restriction

operands.name: the debit and credit of each item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: not negative

preconditions.condition: The journal is a sale journal or a purchase journal.
preconditions.otherwise: No tax summary block is emitted at all.

procedure: Take the Journal Items of the journal inside the window whose tax line is the tax.
Add the debit and subtract the credit of each of them.
Emit the figure beside the net base on the tax's summary row.
records.formula: tax_summary_tax( t ) = Σ over the items in the window whose tax line is t of ( debit − credit )

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: tax amount of the tax
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the tax summary block of the journal section; the row opens the items behind it.

edge_cases.case: A tax produced no tax line.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is zero, which happens for a zero-rated tax.

edge_cases.case: A purchase journal.
edge_cases.outcome: The tax lines sit on the debit side, so the figure is positive.

edge_cases.case: A tax that is a group of taxes.
edge_cases.outcome: Each child tax has its own summary row.

worked_examples.description: The same sale journal and tax
worked_examples.narrative: Zero less two thousand plus three hundred less zero is minus one thousand seven hundred, which is twenty percent of the net base of minus eight thousand five hundred.

records.name: The number of sequence gaps of a journal
records.purpose: Counts the entry numbers that the journal's numbering should have produced inside the window but that no entry carries, so that an auditor can ask about each one.

operands.name: the entry numbers used in the window
operands.source: the Journal Entries of that journal inside the window
operands.constraints: ordered by the sequence number

operands.name: the first and the last number used
operands.source: the same set
operands.constraints: the range the count is made over

preconditions.condition: The journal has at least two entries in the window.
preconditions.otherwise: There is no range and the count is zero.

procedure: Take the entry numbers of the journal inside the window.
Take the first and the last number used as the bounds of the range.
Count the numbers the sequence should have produced between those bounds that no entry carries.
Report the count on the journal row as a finding, not as an error.
records.formula:
sequence_gaps = the count of the numbers the sequence should have produced
                between the first and the last number used in the window,
                that no entry of the journal carries

rounding.what: Nothing is rounded: the result is a count.
rounding.precision: A whole number.
rounding.step: No rounding step.

result.name: the number of gaps
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the journal row of the journal audit; it is a finding an auditor follows up, not a refusal.

edge_cases.case: An entry was deleted before it was posted.
edge_cases.outcome: Its number was never assigned, so it produces no gap.

edge_cases.case: A posted entry was cancelled.
edge_cases.outcome: It keeps its number and produces no gap.

edge_cases.case: A gap is found while the hash chain is being computed.
edge_cases.outcome: The hashing stops with the message that an error occurred when computing the inalterability and that a gap has been detected in the sequence, which must be resolved before the chain can continue.

edge_cases.case: The window covers only part of a numbering period.
edge_cases.outcome: Only the numbers between the first and the last used inside the window are considered.

worked_examples.description: A journal whose entries in the window run from the fourth to the tenth number with two missing
worked_examples.narrative: The range from four to ten holds seven numbers, five of which are carried, so two numbers are missing and the journal row reports two gaps.

records.name: The net figure of a tax in the tax report
records.purpose: Totals the amounts a tax was applied to, negated so that sales read positive, which is the first of the two columns of the shipped tax report.

operands.name: the items of the window whose tax set contains the tax
operands.source: the ledger, restricted by the base restriction with the only-tax-exigible flag on
operands.constraints: the date filter defaults to the previous return period

operands.name: the debit and credit of each item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: not negative

preconditions.condition: The only-tax-exigible flag is set on the report.
preconditions.otherwise: A payment-basis tax whose cash has not moved would be counted before it is due; the three shipped definitions all set the flag.

preconditions.condition: The tax produced a movement in the window.
preconditions.otherwise: No row is emitted for that tax.

procedure: Take the Journal Items of the window whose tax set contains the tax.
Add the debit and subtract the credit of each of them.
Multiply the result by minus one, which makes a sales tax base positive.
Emit the figure in the net column of the tax's row.
records.formula: net( t ) = Σ over the items m in the window whose tax set contains t of ( debit(m) − credit(m) ) × −1

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: net amount of the tax
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the net column of the tax row; the audit action of the cell lists the base items.

edge_cases.case: A purchase tax.
edge_cases.outcome: The same formula yields a negative figure, which the purchase section negates again so that both sections read positive.

edge_cases.case: A tax that is a group of taxes.
edge_cases.outcome: One row is emitted per child tax.

edge_cases.case: The report is grouped by account first.
edge_cases.outcome: One row is emitted per account and then one per tax within it; the two figures per leaf are the same.

edge_cases.case: Three top-level rows exist.
edge_cases.outcome: Sales, purchases, and adjustments when any tax whose type of use is adjustment produced a movement.

worked_examples.description: A standard-rate sales tax over one invoice and one credit note
worked_examples.narrative: The base items total minus eight thousand five hundred and the negation makes the declared net eight thousand five hundred.

records.name: The tax figure of a tax in the tax report
records.purpose: Totals the tax a tax produced, negated so that sales read positive, which is the second of the two columns of the shipped tax report.

operands.name: the items of the window that are the tax line of the tax
operands.source: the ledger, restricted by the base restriction with the only-tax-exigible flag on
operands.constraints: the date filter defaults to the previous return period

operands.name: the debit and credit of each item
operands.source: the Journal Item
operands.constraints: not negative

preconditions.condition: The only-tax-exigible flag is set on the report.
preconditions.otherwise: A payment-basis tax whose cash has not moved would be counted before it is due.

preconditions.condition: The tax produced a tax line in the window.
preconditions.otherwise: The figure is zero for that tax.

procedure: Take the Journal Items of the window whose tax line is the tax.
Add the debit and subtract the credit of each of them.
Multiply the result by minus one.
Emit the figure in the tax column of the tax's row, beside the tax's name and its rate.
records.formula: tax( t ) = Σ over the items m in the window whose tax line is t of ( debit(m) − credit(m) ) × −1

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: tax amount of the tax
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the tax column of the tax row; the audit action of the cell lists the tax items.

edge_cases.case: A purchase tax.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is negative and the purchase section negates it again.

edge_cases.case: The rows are ordered.
edge_cases.outcome: By the tax's own sequence and then by its name, under the top-level row of its type of use.

edge_cases.case: A tax row is unfolded.
edge_cases.outcome: It shows the Journal Items that carry it, split into the base items and the tax items.

worked_examples.description: The same standard-rate sales tax
worked_examples.narrative: The tax items total minus one thousand seven hundred and the negation makes the declared tax one thousand seven hundred, twenty percent of the declared net.

records.name: The double negation of the purchase section of the tax report
records.purpose: Makes the purchase section read positive as well, so that a reader subtracts one section from the other rather than adding two figures of opposite sign.

operands.name: the net figure of a purchase tax
operands.source: the net calculation, already negated once
operands.constraints: negative for an ordinary purchase tax

operands.name: the tax figure of a purchase tax
operands.source: the tax calculation, already negated once
operands.constraints: negative for an ordinary purchase tax

preconditions.condition: The tax's type of use is purchase.
preconditions.otherwise: The row belongs to the sales section or to the adjustments section instead.

procedure: Compute the net figure and the tax figure of the purchase tax with the common formula, which negates once.
Negate the two figures again inside the purchase section.
Display both sections with positive amounts, and let the reader subtract the purchase section from the sales section to obtain the position.
records.formula:
displayed_net( purchase tax ) = −1 × net( t )
displayed_tax( purchase tax ) = −1 × tax( t )
position = sales section − purchase section

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units when the report sets whole-unit rounding.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the sums are accumulated unrounded.

result.name: the purchase section figures
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed as positive amounts in the purchase section of the report.

edge_cases.case: A purchase credit note.
edge_cases.outcome: It reverses the sign of its own items, so it reduces the purchase section as expected.

edge_cases.case: The adjustments section.
edge_cases.outcome: It exists only when a tax whose type of use is adjustment produced a movement, and it follows the sign discipline of its own taxes.

edge_cases.case: The two grouped variants of the report.
edge_cases.outcome: They differ only in the grouping order and compute the same two figures per leaf.

worked_examples.description: A deductible purchase tax over one bill
worked_examples.narrative: The common formula negates the debit totals into negative figures and the purchase section negates them again, so the section shows one hundred and eighty thousand of base and nine thousand of tax as positive amounts.

records.name: The outgoing operation boxes of the Belgian return
records.purpose: Declares the sales side of the national return, with the sign discipline that makes operation boxes and credit-note boxes both read positive.

operands.name: the tag of each box
operands.unit_or_currency: a tax tag named by the box identifier
operands.source: the tax configuration, which stamps the tag on the items its repartition lines generate
operands.constraints: one tag per box, matched for the country of the report

operands.name: the items carrying the tag
operands.source: the ledger over the strict range window, restricted by the base restriction with the only-tax-exigible flag on
operands.constraints: each item contributes its whole balance

operands.name: the leading minus of the formula
operands.source: the report definition
operands.constraints: present on the operation boxes, absent on the credit-note boxes

preconditions.condition: The report declares its country.
preconditions.otherwise: The tags are matched with an empty country and match nothing.

preconditions.condition: Each box's tag exists for that country with the applicability of taxes.
preconditions.otherwise: The box shows zero.

procedure: Evaluate each operation box as the tag total of its own tag, negated, because sales sit on the credit side and the declaration wants a positive figure.
Evaluate each credit-note box as the tag total of its own tag, not negated, because a credit note reverses the sign and the declaration wants the reversal to read positive too.
Show each leaf box in the single column bound to the displayed label.
records.formula:
box_value = −1 × Σ over the items carrying the box's tag of ( debit − credit )    for an operation box
box_value =      Σ over the items carrying the box's tag of ( debit − credit )    for a credit-note box

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units where the legislation declares whole amounts.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: the figure of the box
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the single balance column of the return; every such line audits into the Journal Items carrying its tag.

edge_cases.case: An operation box with a leading minus.
edge_cases.outcome: It reads positive for ordinary sales.

edge_cases.case: A credit-note box without a leading minus.
edge_cases.outcome: It reads positive because the credit note already reversed the ledger sign.

edge_cases.case: A box with no movement.
edge_cases.outcome: It shows zero, not an empty cell.

edge_cases.case: Two expressions in the same country name the same tag with and without a minus.
edge_cases.outcome: They point at the same tag and report opposite figures; a signed pair of tags must never be created.

worked_examples.description: An operation box over one invoice and one credit note of the quarter
worked_examples.narrative: The tag total of minus eight thousand five hundred is negated into a declared eight thousand five hundred.

worked_examples.description: A credit-note box over the same credit note
worked_examples.narrative: The debit of one thousand five hundred is already positive and no negation is applied.

records.name: The sub-box aggregation of the Belgian return
records.purpose: Adds the sub-boxes of an operation box into the box the declaration files, which is how a box that the law splits by kind of operation is presented as one figure with a foldable detail.

operands.name: the figures of the sub-boxes
operands.source: the tag expressions of the sub-box lines
operands.constraints: one per sub-box

operands.name: the aggregation formula of the box
operands.unit_or_currency: an arithmetic over the sub-box codes
operands.source: the report definition
operands.constraints: adds the sub-boxes by their line codes and the displayed label

preconditions.condition: Each sub-box produced a figure.
preconditions.otherwise: A sub-box that produced none contributes zero.

procedure: Evaluate the sub-boxes as tag totals with their own sign discipline.
Add them by their line codes in the aggregation formula of the parent box.
Mark the parent box foldable, so that the reader can open the detail.
records.formula:
box_46 = c46L.balance + c46T.balance
box_48 = c48s44.balance + c48s46L.balance + c48s46T.balance

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units where the legislation declares whole amounts.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: the figure of the aggregated box
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed on the parent line, which is foldable over its sub-boxes; it audits into the union of its operands.

edge_cases.case: A sub-box has no movement.
edge_cases.outcome: It contributes zero and the parent still shows the others.

edge_cases.case: The parent box is folded.
edge_cases.outcome: Its figure is unchanged; folding hides rows, not amounts.

edge_cases.case: The parent is audited.
edge_cases.outcome: The drill-down is the union of the sub-boxes' items.

worked_examples.description: The box that gathers exempted intra-community deliveries and the sales of a chain of three parties
worked_examples.narrative: Forty-two thousand plus seven thousand five hundred is forty-nine thousand five hundred.

worked_examples.description: The box that gathers three kinds of credit note
worked_examples.narrative: One thousand two hundred plus three hundred plus zero is one thousand five hundred.

records.name: The five-expression carry-over pattern of the Belgian incoming boxes
records.purpose: Holds, on one line, the raw tag total, the amount carried in, their sum, the amount to carry out and the displayed figure, which is the complete shape of a box that may go negative.

operands.name: the raw tag total
operands.source: the tag expression of the box over the strict range window
operands.constraints: the period's own movement

operands.name: the amount carried in
operands.source: the external expression that takes the most recent value over the previous return period window
operands.constraints: zero when nothing was carried

operands.name: the unbounded sum
operands.source: an aggregation of the two
operands.constraints: the intermediate figure the two remaining expressions read

operands.name: the amount to carry out
operands.source: an aggregation of the unbounded sum with the clause that keeps a value only below zero
operands.constraints: written when the period is closed

operands.name: the displayed figure
operands.source: an aggregation of the unbounded sum with no bound clause
operands.constraints: the only expression the single column binds to

preconditions.condition: The column binds to the displayed label.
preconditions.otherwise: One of the four intermediate expressions would be shown instead.

preconditions.condition: The carry-in expression uses the previous return period scope.
preconditions.otherwise: The record written on the last day of the previous period is not found.

procedure: Evaluate the raw tag total of the box over the period.
Evaluate the carried-in amount from the carry-over external values of the previous return period.
Add the two into the unbounded sum.
Apply the clause that keeps a value only below zero to the unbounded sum to obtain the amount to carry out.
Show the unbounded sum as the displayed figure, with no bound clause, so that a negative box is rendered as negative and the national filing format writes zero.
records.formula:
tag              = Σ over the items carrying the box's tag of ( debit − credit )
carried_in       = the most recent carry-over external value of the previous return period
balance_unbound  = carried_in + tag
carried_out      = balance_unbound    when balance_unbound < 0, else 0
balance          = balance_unbound

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units where the legislation declares whole amounts.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: the five figures of the box
result.stored_or_displayed: Only the displayed figure is shown, because the single column binds to its label; the other four are intermediate quantities, and the carried-out amount is written as an external value when the period is closed.

edge_cases.case: Six boxes use this pattern.
edge_cases.outcome: The boxes for trade goods, for services and miscellaneous goods, for investment goods, for intra-community acquisitions and the sales of a chain of three parties, for other operations subject to the tax, and for intra-community services with reverse charge.

edge_cases.case: The displayed figure is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: It is shown as negative and the filing format writes zero, which is the flooring left to the filing format.

edge_cases.case: The box audits into its items.
edge_cases.outcome: The drill-down covers the tag expression's items only; the carried-in amount is an external value and is listed separately.

edge_cases.case: Two credit-note boxes of the same section.
edge_cases.outcome: They carry one negated tag expression each and no carry-over pattern at all.

worked_examples.description: A box whose period movement is positive and which carries a negative amount in
worked_examples.narrative: One thousand one hundred and thirty plus minus four hundred and twenty is seven hundred and ten, which is not below zero, so nothing is carried out and seven hundred and ten is displayed.

worked_examples.description: The same box in a period whose movement is negative
worked_examples.narrative: Minus four hundred and twenty is below zero, so the whole amount is carried out while the box still displays minus four hundred and twenty and the filing format writes zero.

records.name: The taxes due to the State of the Belgian return
records.purpose: Computes the amount the company must pay, as the difference between the tax due side and the deductible side, floored at zero so that a reclaim position leaves this box empty.

operands.name: the six due boxes
operands.source: the tag expressions of the due section, each with a leading minus
operands.constraints: positive when tax is owed

operands.name: the three deductible boxes
operands.source: the tag expressions of the deductible section, none with a minus
operands.constraints: positive because deductible tax sits on the debit side

preconditions.condition: Every operand box produced a figure.
preconditions.otherwise: A box that produced none contributes zero.

preconditions.condition: The complementary box uses the exact negation of this formula with the same floor.
preconditions.otherwise: Both boxes could be non-zero, or both zero, in the same period.

procedure: Add the six boxes of the due section.
Add the three boxes of the deductible section.
Subtract the deductible side from the due side.
Show the result when it is strictly above zero, and show zero otherwise.
records.formula:
due_side        = c54.balance + c55.balance + c56.balance + c57.balance + c61.balance + c63.balance
deductible_side = c59.balance + c62.balance + c64.balance
line_71         = due_side − deductible_side    when that difference > 0, else 0

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units where the legislation declares whole amounts.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: taxes due to the State
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the balance section of the return; it audits into the union of its operands.

edge_cases.case: The position is a reclaim.
edge_cases.outcome: The difference is not above zero and the box shows zero, while the complementary box carries the whole position.

edge_cases.case: The position is exactly zero.
edge_cases.outcome: Both boxes show zero.

edge_cases.case: This is the canonical split.
edge_cases.outcome: Almost every national definition splits the net position into a box to pay and a box to reclaim in exactly this way.

worked_examples.description: A quarter in which the company owes tax
worked_examples.narrative: The due side totals thirteen thousand six hundred and seven and the deductible side nine thousand seven hundred and forty, so the difference of three thousand eight hundred and sixty-seven is above zero and is declared.

records.name: The amount owed by the State of the Belgian return
records.purpose: Computes the amount the authorities must refund, as the exact negation of the amount due, floored at zero so that exactly one of the two balance boxes is non-zero.

operands.name: the three deductible boxes
operands.source: the tag expressions of the deductible section
operands.constraints: positive because deductible tax sits on the debit side

operands.name: the six due boxes
operands.source: the tag expressions of the due section
operands.constraints: positive when tax is owed

preconditions.condition: Every operand box produced a figure.
preconditions.otherwise: A box that produced none contributes zero.

preconditions.condition: The complementary box uses the exact negation of this formula with the same floor.
preconditions.otherwise: The conservation of the position across the two boxes fails.

procedure: Add the three boxes of the deductible section.
Add the six boxes of the due section.
Subtract the due side from the deductible side.
Show the result when it is strictly above zero, and show zero otherwise.
records.formula:
deductible_side = c59.balance + c62.balance + c64.balance
due_side        = c54.balance + c55.balance + c56.balance + c57.balance + c61.balance + c63.balance
line_72         = deductible_side − due_side    when that difference > 0, else 0

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and whole units where the legislation declares whole amounts.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: amount owed by the State
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the balance section of the return; it audits into the union of its operands.

edge_cases.case: The position is a payment.
edge_cases.outcome: The difference is not above zero and the box shows zero.

edge_cases.case: Both boxes are floored at zero and the formulas are exact negations.
edge_cases.outcome: Exactly one of the two is non-zero in any period, and both are zero when the position is exactly zero.

edge_cases.case: The box is audited.
edge_cases.outcome: The drill-down is the union of the operand boxes' items.

worked_examples.description: The same quarter, in which the company owes tax
worked_examples.narrative: Nine thousand seven hundred and forty less thirteen thousand six hundred and seven is minus three thousand eight hundred and sixty-seven, which is not above zero, so the box shows zero.

records.name: The tax derived from a typed base at the standard rate
records.purpose: Derives the tax of the adjustment box for imported goods from a base the filer types by hand, at the standard rate of five percent, which is the only box of the definition whose tax is computed rather than read from the ledger.

operands.name: the typed base
operands.source: the editable external expression of the box, whose subformula makes the cell editable with two decimals
operands.constraints: typed by a user holding the accounting manager group

operands.name: the standard rate
operands.source: the formula of the aggregation expression
operands.constraints: five hundredths

preconditions.condition: The base cell carries the clause that makes it editable.
preconditions.otherwise: A manual figure cannot be typed at all.

preconditions.condition: The user holds the accounting manager group.
preconditions.otherwise: The write is refused.

procedure: Read the base the filer typed into the editable cell, rounded to two decimals.
Multiply it by five hundredths.
Show the product in the tax column of the same box.
records.formula: uae_7.tax = uae_7.base × 0.05

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and two decimals on every editable adjustment cell of this definition.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: the tax of the box for adjustments to imported goods
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the tax column of the box and read by the totals line of the section; the base cell audits into the external value records, and the tax cell is derived.

edge_cases.case: Nothing is typed into the base cell.
edge_cases.outcome: The base is zero and the tax is zero.

edge_cases.case: The base is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: The tax is negative, which the totals line carries through.

edge_cases.case: The rate changes in law.
edge_cases.outcome: The definition carries the rate as a literal, so the definition changes rather than the engine.

worked_examples.description: A quarter in which the filer types sixty-four thousand into the base of the box
worked_examples.narrative: Sixty-four thousand times five hundredths is three thousand two hundred.

records.name: The totals line of the sales section of the return of the United Arab Emirates
records.purpose: Adds the thirteen bases, the eleven taxes and the seven adjustments of the sales section into the three figures the section files.

operands.name: the base figures of the thirteen sales boxes
operands.source: the tag expressions of the seven emirate boxes and of the six other boxes, and the editable base of the adjustment box
operands.constraints: boxes for zero-rated and exempt supplies carry a base and no tax

operands.name: the tax figures of the eleven sales boxes
operands.source: the tag expressions and the derived tax of the adjustment box
operands.constraints: the zero-rated and exempt boxes contribute none

operands.name: the adjustment figures of the seven emirate boxes
operands.source: the editable external expressions of the seven emirate boxes
operands.constraints: typed by the filer

preconditions.condition: Each referenced box produced a figure.
preconditions.otherwise: A box that produced none contributes zero.

procedure: Add the base figures of the seven emirate boxes, of the tourist refund box, of the reverse-charge box, of the zero-rated box, of the exempt box, of the imported-goods box and of the adjustment box.
Add the tax figures of the seven emirate boxes, of the tourist refund box, of the reverse-charge box, of the imported-goods box and of the adjustment box.
Add the adjustment figures of the seven emirate boxes.
Show the three totals in the three columns of the totals line.
records.formula:
uae_8.base = uae_1a.base + uae_1b.base + uae_1c.base + uae_1d.base + uae_1e.base
           + uae_1f.base + uae_1g.base + uae_2.base + uae_3.base + uae_4.base
           + uae_5.base + uae_6.base + uae_7.base

uae_8.tax  = uae_1a.tax + uae_1b.tax + uae_1c.tax + uae_1d.tax + uae_1e.tax
           + uae_1f.tax + uae_1g.tax + uae_2.tax + uae_3.tax + uae_6.tax + uae_7.tax

uae_8.adj  = uae_1a.adj + uae_1b.adj + uae_1c.adj + uae_1d.adj + uae_1e.adj
           + uae_1f.adj + uae_1g.adj

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and two decimals on every editable adjustment cell of this definition.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: the three totals of the sales section
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the three columns of the totals line; the line audits into the union of its operands.

edge_cases.case: The zero-rated box and the exempt box.
edge_cases.outcome: They contribute a base and no tax, because such supplies carry none.

edge_cases.case: The reverse-charge box.
edge_cases.outcome: Its base carries no leading minus while its tax does, which the totals carry through unchanged.

edge_cases.case: No adjustment is typed.
edge_cases.outcome: The adjustment total is zero.

edge_cases.case: Only seven boxes carry an adjustment.
edge_cases.outcome: The seven emirate boxes; the adjustment total sums those seven only.

worked_examples.description: A quarter with standard-rated supplies in one emirate and an adjustment for imported goods
worked_examples.narrative: Four hundred thousand plus sixty-four thousand is four hundred and sixty-four thousand of base; twenty thousand plus three thousand two hundred is twenty-three thousand two hundred of tax; no adjustment was typed, so that total is zero.

records.name: The totals line of the expenses section of the return of the United Arab Emirates
records.purpose: Adds the two expense boxes into the three figures of the section, which carry no leading minus because input tax sits on the debit side.

operands.name: the base and tax figures of the standard-rated expenses box
operands.source: its two tag expressions, neither negated
operands.constraints: positive for ordinary purchases

operands.name: the base and tax figures of the reverse-charge expenses box
operands.source: its two tag expressions, neither negated
operands.constraints: positive for ordinary purchases

operands.name: the adjustment of the standard-rated expenses box
operands.source: its editable external expression
operands.constraints: the only adjustment of the section

preconditions.condition: Each referenced box produced a figure.
preconditions.otherwise: A box that produced none contributes zero.

procedure: Add the base figures of the two expense boxes.
Add the tax figures of the two expense boxes.
Take the adjustment of the standard-rated expenses box as the adjustment total, because it is the only adjustment of the section.
Show the three totals in the three columns of the totals line.
records.formula:
uae_11.base = uae_9.base + uae_10.base
uae_11.tax  = uae_9.tax  + uae_10.tax
uae_11.adj  = uae_9.adj

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and two decimals on every editable adjustment cell of this definition.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: the three totals of the expenses section
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the three columns of the totals line; the line audits into the union of its operands.

edge_cases.case: The input boxes carry no leading minus.
edge_cases.outcome: Input tax sits on the debit side and is already positive.

edge_cases.case: The reverse-charge expenses box.
edge_cases.outcome: It carries both a base and a tax and enters both totals.

edge_cases.case: No adjustment is typed.
edge_cases.outcome: The adjustment total is zero.

worked_examples.description: A quarter with standard-rated expenses only
worked_examples.narrative: One hundred and eighty thousand of base and nine thousand of tax pass through unchanged, and no adjustment was typed.

records.name: The total value of due tax for the period of the return of the United Arab Emirates
records.purpose: Adds the tax total of the sales section to its adjustment total, giving the tax the company owes before deduction.

operands.name: the tax total of the sales section
operands.source: the totals line of the sales section
operands.constraints: already summed over the eleven boxes

operands.name: the adjustment total of the sales section
operands.source: the same totals line
operands.constraints: already summed over the seven emirate boxes

preconditions.condition: The totals line of the sales section produced its figures.
preconditions.otherwise: The operands contribute zero.

procedure: Read the tax total of the sales section.
Read the adjustment total of the sales section.
Add the two.
records.formula: uae_12.tax = uae_8.tax + uae_8.adj

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and two decimals on every editable adjustment cell of this definition.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: total value of due tax for the period
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the net section of the return; it audits into the union of its operands.

edge_cases.case: No adjustment is typed.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure equals the tax total of the sales section.

edge_cases.case: An adjustment is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: It reduces the due tax, which is what an adjustment in favour of the filer means.

edge_cases.case: The line is audited.
edge_cases.outcome: The drill-down covers both operands.

worked_examples.description: The same quarter
worked_examples.narrative: Twenty-three thousand two hundred plus zero is twenty-three thousand two hundred.

records.name: The total value of recoverable tax for the period of the return of the United Arab Emirates
records.purpose: Adds the tax total of the expenses section to its adjustment total, giving the tax the company may reclaim.

operands.name: the tax total of the expenses section
operands.source: the totals line of the expenses section
operands.constraints: already summed over the two boxes

operands.name: the adjustment total of the expenses section
operands.source: the same totals line
operands.constraints: the adjustment of the standard-rated expenses box

preconditions.condition: The totals line of the expenses section produced its figures.
preconditions.otherwise: The operands contribute zero.

procedure: Read the tax total of the expenses section.
Read the adjustment total of the expenses section.
Add the two.
records.formula: uae_13.tax = uae_11.tax + uae_11.adj

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and two decimals on every editable adjustment cell of this definition.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: total value of recoverable tax for the period
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the net section of the return; it audits into the union of its operands.

edge_cases.case: No adjustment is typed.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure equals the tax total of the expenses section.

edge_cases.case: An adjustment is negative.
edge_cases.outcome: It reduces the recoverable tax.

edge_cases.case: The line is audited.
edge_cases.outcome: The drill-down covers both operands.

worked_examples.description: The same quarter
worked_examples.narrative: Nine thousand plus zero is nine thousand.

records.name: The payable tax for the period of the return of the United Arab Emirates
records.purpose: Declares one single net figure that may be negative, which is the variant where a negative figure means a refund is due rather than a box that must be floored.

operands.name: the total value of due tax
operands.source: the due tax line
operands.constraints: the sales side

operands.name: the total value of recoverable tax
operands.source: the recoverable tax line
operands.constraints: the expenses side

preconditions.condition: Both lines produced their figures.
preconditions.otherwise: The operands contribute zero.

preconditions.condition: The line carries no bound clause.
preconditions.otherwise: The definition would floor the figure, which this return deliberately does not do.

procedure: Read the total value of due tax for the period.
Read the total value of recoverable tax for the period.
Subtract the second from the first.
Show the result as it stands, negative included, because a negative figure means a refund is due.
records.formula: uae_14.tax = uae_12.tax − uae_13.tax

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency, and two decimals on every editable adjustment cell of this definition.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: payable tax for the period
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed as the last line of the return; a negative figure means the authorities owe the company.

edge_cases.case: The recoverable tax exceeds the due tax.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is negative and a refund is due; the line is deliberately not floored.

edge_cases.case: The two sides are equal.
edge_cases.outcome: The figure is zero and nothing is paid or refunded.

edge_cases.case: This definition is compared with the split of a pay box and a reclaim box.
edge_cases.outcome: It declares a single net figure instead, which is why no carry-over pattern is needed.

worked_examples.description: The same quarter
worked_examples.narrative: Twenty-three thousand two hundred less nine thousand is fourteen thousand two hundred, which the company pays.

records.name: The split of the tax due or deductible of the Italian monthly return
records.purpose: Splits the difference between the tax due and the tax deductible of the month into a debit column and a credit column, each floored at zero, so that exactly one of the two carries the position.

operands.name: the tax due of the month
operands.source: the tag expression of the box for the tax due, with a leading minus
operands.constraints: positive when tax is owed

operands.name: the tax deductible of the month
operands.source: the tag expression of the box for the deductible tax, with no minus
operands.constraints: positive because deductible tax sits on the debit side

preconditions.condition: Both boxes produced a figure.
preconditions.otherwise: A box that produced none contributes zero.

preconditions.condition: Both expressions carry the floor at zero.
preconditions.otherwise: Both columns could be non-zero in the same month.

procedure: Subtract the deductible tax from the tax due; show the result in the debit column when it is above zero, and zero otherwise.
Subtract the tax due from the deductible tax; show the result in the credit column when it is above zero, and zero otherwise.
Observe that exactly one of the two columns is non-zero unless the two boxes are equal.
records.formula:
VP6.debit  = VP4.debit − VP5.credit    when that difference > 0, else 0
VP6.credit = VP5.credit − VP4.debit    when that difference > 0, else 0

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: the debit and the credit of the tax due or deductible box
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the two columns of the return; both are read by the result line of the tax account section.

edge_cases.case: The two boxes are equal.
edge_cases.outcome: Both columns show zero.

edge_cases.case: The month is in credit.
edge_cases.outcome: The debit column shows zero and the credit column carries the whole position.

edge_cases.case: The two formulas are exact negations of each other.
edge_cases.outcome: They are both floored at zero, which is the canonical split pattern.

worked_examples.description: A month with a tax due of eight thousand four hundred and a deductible tax of eight thousand three hundred and fifty-five
worked_examples.narrative: Eight thousand four hundred less eight thousand three hundred and fifty-five is forty-five, which is above zero and goes to the debit column; the reverse difference of minus forty-five is not above zero, so the credit column shows zero.

records.name: The carry-in boxes of the Italian monthly return
records.purpose: Adds what the previous period carried to the month's own tag total, on the three boxes that receive a debt, a credit or a previous year's credit.

operands.name: the tag total of the box
operands.source: the tag expression of the box over the strict range window
operands.constraints: signed by the box's own sign discipline

operands.name: the amount carried in
operands.source: the external expression that takes the most recent value over the previous return period window
operands.constraints: zero when nothing was carried

operands.name: the displayed label of the box
operands.unit_or_currency: the debit label or the credit label
operands.source: the report definition
operands.constraints: the debt box uses the debit column and the two credit boxes use the credit column

preconditions.condition: The carry-in expression uses the previous return period scope.
preconditions.otherwise: The record written on the last day of the previous month is not found.

preconditions.condition: The company's periodicity is monthly.
preconditions.otherwise: The previous return period means something else and a record can be orphaned.

procedure: Evaluate the tag total of the box over the month.
Evaluate the carried-in amount over the previous return period.
Add the two into the displayed figure of the box, in the debit column for the box that receives a previous debt and in the credit column for the two boxes that receive a credit.
records.formula:
VP7.debit  = VP7._applied_carryover_debit  + VP7.tag
VP8.credit = VP8._applied_carryover_credit + VP8.tag
VP9.credit = VP9._applied_carryover_balance + VP9.tag

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: the figures of the three carry-in boxes
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the debit or the credit column of each box and read by the result line of the tax account section.

edge_cases.case: Nothing was carried in.
edge_cases.outcome: The box shows its own tag total alone.

edge_cases.case: The box for a previous period debt.
edge_cases.outcome: It receives only a debt below one hundred, because the carry-out expression that feeds it carries the clamp between zero and one hundred.

edge_cases.case: The box for a previous year credit.
edge_cases.outcome: Its carry-in expression uses the label of an applied carry-over over the balance, which is a third label on a definition whose columns are the debit and the credit.

worked_examples.description: A month that carries a debt of forty-five in, with no tag movement of its own
worked_examples.narrative: Zero plus forty-five is forty-five, which the box for the previous period debt shows in the debit column.

records.name: The tax payable of the Italian monthly return
records.purpose: Computes the amount the company owes for the month, as the difference between the debit side and the credit side of the return, floored at zero.

operands.name: the debit operands
operands.source: the debit column of the tax due or deductible box, the debit of the previous period debt box and the debit of the interest box
operands.constraints: each may be zero

operands.name: the credit operands
operands.source: the credit column of the tax due or deductible box, and the credits of the previous period credit box, the previous year credit box, the intra-community car payments box, the tax credit box and the down payment box
operands.constraints: each may be zero

preconditions.condition: Every operand box produced a figure.
preconditions.otherwise: A box that produced none contributes zero.

preconditions.condition: The credit result line uses the exact negation of this formula with the same floor.
preconditions.otherwise: Both result lines could be non-zero in the same month.

procedure: Add the three debit operands.
Add the six credit operands.
Subtract the credit side from the debit side.
Show the result when it is strictly above zero, and show zero otherwise.
records.formula:
VP14.debit = ( VP6.debit + VP7.debit + VP12.debit )
           − ( VP6.credit + VP8.credit + VP9.credit + VP10.credit + VP11.credit + VP13.credit )
           when that difference > 0, else 0

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: tax payable for the month
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the debit column of the result line, and read by the carry-out expression that may transfer a small debt to the next month.

edge_cases.case: The month is in credit.
edge_cases.outcome: The line shows zero and the credit result line carries the position.

edge_cases.case: The debt is below one hundred.
edge_cases.outcome: It is declared here and also carried out by the clamp, so that the next month's box for a previous period debt receives it.

edge_cases.case: The line is audited.
edge_cases.outcome: The drill-down is the union of its operands.

worked_examples.description: A month whose only movement is a tax due of forty-five
worked_examples.narrative: Forty-five plus zero plus zero, less six zeros, is forty-five, which is above zero and is declared.

records.name: The tax credit of the Italian monthly return
records.purpose: Computes the amount the authorities owe for the month, as the exact negation of the tax payable, floored at zero.

operands.name: the credit operands
operands.source: the credit column of the tax due or deductible box and the credits of the five other credit boxes
operands.constraints: each may be zero

operands.name: the debit operands
operands.source: the debit column of the tax due or deductible box, the previous period debt box and the interest box
operands.constraints: each may be zero

preconditions.condition: Every operand box produced a figure.
preconditions.otherwise: A box that produced none contributes zero.

preconditions.condition: The debit result line uses the exact negation of this formula with the same floor.
preconditions.otherwise: The conservation of the position across the two lines fails.

procedure: Add the six credit operands.
Add the three debit operands.
Subtract the debit side from the credit side.
Show the result when it is strictly above zero, and show zero otherwise.
records.formula:
VP14.credit = ( VP6.credit + VP8.credit + VP9.credit + VP10.credit + VP11.credit + VP13.credit )
            − ( VP6.debit + VP7.debit + VP12.debit )
            when that difference > 0, else 0

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: tax credit for the month
result.stored_or_displayed: Displayed in the credit column of the result line, and read by the carry-out expression that transfers any credit to the next month.

edge_cases.case: The month is in debt.
edge_cases.outcome: The line shows zero.

edge_cases.case: Any credit at all.
edge_cases.outcome: It is carried to the next month's box for a previous period credit, because that carry-out expression floors at zero only.

edge_cases.case: The two result lines are exact negations.
edge_cases.outcome: Exactly one of the two is non-zero unless the position is zero.

worked_examples.description: The same month, which is in debt
worked_examples.narrative: Zero less forty-five is minus forty-five, which is not above zero, so the credit column of the result line shows zero.

records.name: The small debt carried out of the Italian monthly return
records.purpose: Carries a debt of less than one hundred into the next month rather than requiring its payment, using the clamp between zero and one hundred and an explicit carry-over target.

operands.name: the tax payable of the month
operands.source: the debit column of the result line
operands.constraints: already floored at zero

operands.name: the clamp bounds
operands.source: the clause of the subformula, written as zero and one hundred in euros
operands.constraints: the value is clamped, not zeroed

operands.name: the explicit carry-over target
operands.source: the carry-over target field of the expression
operands.constraints: names the carry-in expression of the box for a previous period debt

preconditions.condition: The carry-over target is stated explicitly.
preconditions.otherwise: The automatic resolution looks on the same line only, and the carry-in expression lives on another line, so it could not be found.

preconditions.condition: The period is actually closed.
preconditions.otherwise: The amount is computed and remembered but no record is written.

procedure: Read the tax payable of the month.
Apply the clamp: keep the figure when it lies strictly between zero and one hundred, return zero when it is at or below zero, and return one hundred when it is at or above one hundred.
When the period is closed and the result is not zero, write one external value targeting the carry-in expression of the box for a previous period debt, dated the last day of the month.
records.formula:
VP14._carryover_debit = VP14.debit    when 0 < VP14.debit < 100
VP14._carryover_debit = 0             when VP14.debit ≤ 0
VP14._carryover_debit = 100           when VP14.debit ≥ 100

rounding.precision: The decimal places of the presentation currency.
rounding.step: Once, at display; the operands are read unrounded.

result.name: the debt carried to the next month
